senses.en: to make someone eager to do something
to provide the reason for someone's actions

ex.en: Training with a friend motivates me to exercise regularly.
ex.zh: 和朋友一起训练能激励我坚持锻炼。

ex.en: Teachers can motivate students to explore difficult subjects by connecting classroom lessons with everyday experiences.
ex.zh: 教师可以把课堂内容与日常经历联系起来，激励学生探索难学的科目。

col: motivate someone to do something｜激励某人做某事
words.tip: 常用motivate sb to do；by后可接动机。

senses.en: the feeling of being annoyed
soreness or discomfort in a part of the body

ex.en: He sighed with irritation when the phone rang again.
ex.zh: 电话又响了，他烦躁地叹了口气。

ex.en: Exposure to household cleaning products may cause skin irritation, especially among people with sensitive skin.
ex.zh: 接触家用清洁产品可能引起皮肤刺激，皮肤敏感者尤其如此。

col: a source of irritation｜令人恼火的事物
words.tip: 既可指情绪上的恼怒，也可指皮肤等受到刺激。

senses.en: A large hole in the ground
An area where racing cars stop for servicing
The hard central part of certain fruits

ex.en: We dug a shallow pit for the new tree.
ex.zh: 我们挖了一个浅坑，准备栽这棵新树。

ex.en: Abandoned mining pits can threaten local ecosystems unless restoration projects stabilise the soil and improve water quality.
ex.zh: 废弃矿坑可能威胁当地生态系统，除非修复项目能稳固土壤并改善水质。

col: a pit stop｜赛车进站检修
words.tip: 维修区常用the pits；果核义主要用于美式英语。

senses.en: The study of knowledge, existence, reality, and moral values
A set of beliefs that guides actions and decisions

ex.en: My sister studies philosophy and enjoys discussing difficult questions.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习哲学，喜欢讨论难解的问题。

ex.en: Studying philosophy can help students question assumptions and develop stronger arguments about complex ethical issues.
ex.zh: 学习哲学有助于学生质疑既有假设，并就复杂的伦理问题提出更有力的论证。

words.tip: 指学科通常不可数；指某套理念可用a philosophy。

senses.en: A short trip to buy, collect, or deliver something

ex.en: I ran an errand before meeting you for lunch.
ex.zh: 和你见面吃午饭前，我出去办了点事。

ex.en: Reliable neighbourhood transport helps older residents run errands independently and maintain regular contact with their communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的社区交通能帮助老年居民独立外出办事，并与社区保持日常联系。

col: send someone on an errand｜派某人跑腿
a quick errand｜很快能办完的差事
words.tip: 通常指外出办小事；常搭配run errands。

senses.en: extremely beautiful or impressive
causing great surprise or shock

ex.en: We enjoyed a stunning view from the hilltop.
ex.zh: 我们在山顶欣赏了绝美的景色。

ex.en: The region's stunning coastal scenery attracts visitors, but increased tourism places pressure on fragile ecosystems.
ex.zh: 该地区绝美的海岸风光吸引着游客，但旅游业增长也给脆弱的生态系统带来压力。

col: a stunning victory｜令人震惊的胜利
words.tip: stunning形容事物令人惊叹；stunned形容人惊呆了。

senses.en: a thick sweet liquid made from dissolved sugar
a sweet thick liquid containing medicine

ex.en: She poured a little syrup over her warm pancakes.
ex.zh: 她在热乎乎的煎饼上浇了一点糖浆。

ex.en: Fruit preserved in syrup often contains more added sugar than fresh fruit, which may concern health-conscious consumers.
ex.zh: 糖浆保存的水果通常比新鲜水果含有更多添加糖，这可能让注重健康的消费者担忧。

words.tip: 通常不可数；止咳糖浆说cough syrup。

senses.en: A statement about what is likely to happen in the future.
To say what will probably happen, using available information.

ex.en: The weather forecast says we should expect snow tonight.
ex.zh: 天气预报说今晚可能会下雪。

ex.en: Economists forecast slower growth next year as rising energy costs place greater pressure on businesses.
ex.zh: 经济学家预测，随着能源成本上涨给企业带来更大压力，明年的经济增长将放缓。

words.tip: 过去式和过去分词通常用forecast，也可用forecasted。

senses.en: A small amount of air, smoke, or steam released suddenly.
To breathe quickly and noisily after physical effort.
To release air or smoke, or swell with air.

ex.en: A puff of steam escaped from the kettle.
ex.zh: 一小团蒸汽从水壶里冒了出来。

ex.en: Older buses release puffs of dark smoke, highlighting the need for cleaner public transport in cities.
ex.zh: 老旧公交车排出一团团黑烟，凸显了城市发展更清洁公共交通的必要性。

col: puff out your cheeks｜鼓起腮帮子
words.tip: 一团烟用a puff of smoke；puff也可表示喘粗气。

senses.en: A legally protected name or symbol identifying a company's products.
A distinctive feature strongly associated with someone or something.
To register a name or symbol for legal protection.

ex.en: The bakery's trademark is a tiny golden wheat stalk.
ex.zh: 这家面包店的商标是一株小小的金色麦穗。

ex.en: Registering a trademark helps small businesses protect their identity and distinguish their products from those of competitors.
ex.zh: 注册商标有助于小企业保护自身品牌形象，并使其产品区别于竞争对手的产品。

words.tip: 商标用trademark；版权用copyright，保护对象不同。

senses.en: Products applied to the face or body to improve appearance.

ex.en: She keeps her cosmetics in a small bathroom drawer.
ex.zh: 她把化妆品放在浴室的一个小抽屉里。

ex.en: Consumers increasingly expect cosmetics manufacturers to disclose ingredients clearly and reduce unnecessary packaging to limit environmental damage.
ex.zh: 消费者越来越希望化妆品制造商明确公开成分，并减少不必要的包装以降低环境危害。

words.tip: 通常用复数；cosmetic作形容词也指表面的。

senses.zh: 亲切友善的；易于交谈的
senses.en: friendly and easy to talk to
easy to understand or enjoy without special knowledge

ex.en: Our new teacher seems approachable, so I asked for help.
ex.zh: 我们的新老师看起来很亲切，所以我向老师求助了。

ex.en: Approachable healthcare professionals may encourage patients to discuss sensitive concerns before their conditions become more serious.
ex.zh: 亲切的医护人员可能促使患者在病情加重前谈及难以启齿的顾虑。

col: friendly and approachable｜友善且平易近人的
an approachable style｜浅显易懂的风格
words.tip: 形容人时重在容易交谈、让人敢于求助。

senses.en: To let someone or something go free or escape.
To make information or a product available to the public.
The act of freeing or publishing; something newly made available.

ex.en: We released the butterfly outside after checking its wings.
ex.zh: 检查过蝴蝶的翅膀后，我们把它放到了室外。

ex.en: Governments should release reliable environmental data so that citizens can evaluate the effectiveness of climate policies.
ex.zh: 政府应公布可靠的环境数据，让公民能够评估气候政策的成效。

words.tip: release可指释放，也可指公开发布报告或产品。

senses.en: making you feel affection, sympathy, or gentle sadness
putting a hand or another body part against something

ex.en: Her touching farewell brought tears to my eyes.
ex.zh: 她感人的道别让我热泪盈眶。

ex.en: The documentary offers a touching account of volunteers helping older residents overcome loneliness in urban communities.
ex.zh: 这部纪录片动人地讲述了志愿者帮助城市社区的老年居民克服孤独的故事。

words.tip: touching形容事情感人；touched形容人受到感动。

senses.en: someone with little experience in a particular activity

ex.en: As a gardening novice, I often forget to water seedlings.
ex.zh: 作为园艺新手，我常常忘记给幼苗浇水。

ex.en: Structured mentoring can help a novice develop the confidence needed to manage a classroom effectively.
ex.zh: 有系统的指导能帮助新手建立有效管理课堂所需的信心。

words.tip: 表示某方面的新手，常用a novice at/in。

senses.en: of a satisfactory or reasonably good standard
honest, kind, or socially acceptable

ex.en: We finally found a decent flat near the station.
ex.zh: 我们终于在车站附近找到了一套像样的公寓。

ex.en: Every worker should earn enough to afford decent housing and meet their basic needs.
ex.zh: 每位劳动者都应有足够的收入，住上像样的住房并满足基本需求。

words.tip: 表示质量时是“还不错”，不等于“极好”。

senses.en: a place where young children are cared for
a place where young plants are grown for sale
a room in a home for a baby or young child

ex.en: My daughter painted a bright yellow duck at nursery.
ex.zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的鸭子。

ex.en: Affordable nursery places allow more parents to return to work while their children receive professional care.
ex.zh: 价格可负担的托幼名额能让更多父母重返职场，同时让孩子得到专业照护。

words.tip: 英式英语中at nursery常指在托儿所。

senses.en: A person with deep knowledge of an academic subject.
A student awarded money to study because of their abilities.

ex.en: The scholar carefully examined an old book in the library.
ex.zh: 这位学者在图书馆仔细研究一本古书。

ex.en: Scholars increasingly argue that access to early education can reduce social inequality over the long term.
ex.zh: 越来越多学者认为，获得早期教育的机会能够长期减少社会不平等。

words.tip: scholar通常指学者，不是普通学生。

senses.en: A large public meeting supporting a cause or expressing opinions.
To gather people together to support someone or something.
To regain strength or improve after a difficult period.

ex.en: Hundreds attended a peaceful rally in the town square.
ex.zh: 数百人参加了镇广场上的和平集会。

ex.en: Community leaders rallied support for a public library, arguing that free access to information benefits everyone.
ex.zh: 社区领袖争取大家支持建设公共图书馆，认为免费获取信息能让所有人受益。

col: rally around someone｜团结起来支持某人
words.tip: rally support for表示“为……争取支持”。

senses.en: The quality of staying similar in behaviour, standards, or results.
How thick, firm, or smooth a substance is.

ex.en: Our coach values consistency more than occasional brilliant performances.
ex.zh: 我们的教练更看重稳定发挥，而不是偶尔的出色表现。

ex.en: Greater consistency in marking standards would help ensure that students receive fair results across different examination centres.
ex.zh: 提高评分标准的一致性，有助于确保不同考点的学生获得公平的成绩。

col: consistency in quality｜质量的稳定性
a smooth consistency｜细腻均匀的质地
words.tip: 表示某方面的一致性用 consistency in。

senses.en: a mention of someone or something
consultation for information, or a source used in writing
a recommendation or someone who recommends you for work

ex.en: Her speech included a warm reference to her grandmother.
ex.zh: 她在演讲中温情地提到了祖母。

ex.en: Academic essays should include accurate references so readers can locate the original sources of information.
ex.zh: 学术文章应包含准确的引文出处，以便读者找到信息的原始来源。

words.tip: reference to表示提及；for reference表示供参考。

senses.en: The belief that good things will happen.

ex.en: Her optimism helped us stay cheerful during the storm.
ex.zh: 暴风雨期间，她的乐观让我们保持了好心情。

ex.en: Despite economic uncertainty, many graduates express optimism about their chances of finding meaningful employment.
ex.zh: 尽管经济形势不明朗，许多毕业生仍对找到有意义的工作持乐观态度。

col: optimism about the future｜对未来的乐观态度
words.tip: 不可数名词；对某事乐观常用optimism about。

senses.en: A belief or rule that guides decisions and behaviour.
A basic truth explaining how something works.

ex.en: I refused the extra money as a matter of principle.
ex.zh: 出于原则，我拒绝了那笔额外的钱。

ex.en: The principle of equal opportunity should guide policies designed to improve access to higher education.
ex.zh: 旨在改善高等教育入学机会的政策应以机会平等原则为指导。

col: basic principle｜基本原则；基本原理
words.tip: 勿混principal：它可指“主要的”或“校长”。

senses.en: A group of flowers arranged together, usually as a gift.
The characteristic pleasant smell of a wine.

ex.en: She brought a bright bouquet to her grandmother's birthday dinner.
ex.zh: 她带着一束鲜艳的花来参加祖母的生日晚餐。

ex.en: Choosing a bouquet of locally grown flowers can reduce the environmental impact associated with long-distance transport.
ex.zh: 选择一束本地种植的鲜花，可以减少长途运输带来的环境影响。

col: a bouquet of flowers｜一束鲜花
a bouquet of roses｜一束玫瑰
words.tip: 末尾t不发音；一束花用a bouquet of flowers。

senses.en: to put a plan or decision into action
a tool used for a particular task

ex.en: Our team will implement the new schedule next week.
ex.zh: 我们团队下周将实行新的时间表。

ex.en: Governments should implement policies that make public transport more affordable for people on low incomes.
ex.zh: 政府应实施相关政策，让低收入人群更负担得起公共交通。

words.tip: 动词重音在首音节；名词末音节读/mənt/。

senses.en: To make certain that something happens or is true

ex.en: Please ensure that all windows are closed before leaving.
ex.zh: 离开前请确保所有窗户都已关好。

ex.en: Governments should ensure that affordable public transport is available to residents in both urban and rural areas.
ex.zh: 政府应确保城市和农村居民都能享有价格实惠的公共交通。

words.tip: ensure接名词或that从句；insure指投保。

senses.en: A biological group whose members can usually breed with one another.

ex.en: Several species of butterfly visit our garden each summer.
ex.zh: 每年夏天都有几种蝴蝶来到我们的花园。

ex.en: Protecting natural habitats is essential for preventing the extinction of species threatened by human activity.
ex.zh: 保护自然栖息地对于防止受人类活动威胁的物种灭绝至关重要。

words.tip: 单复数同形：one species，many species。

senses.en: How much something happens or how far it reaches.

ex.en: We only discovered the extent of the leak yesterday.
ex.zh: 我们昨天才发现漏水有多严重。

ex.en: The extent to which public transport reduces pollution depends on passenger numbers and energy sources.
ex.zh: 公共交通能在多大程度上减少污染，取决于乘客数量和能源来源。

col: to some extent｜在某种程度上
the full extent of｜……的全部程度或范围
to a large extent｜在很大程度上
words.tip: 表示“在某种程度上”用to some extent。

senses.en: a sharp, curved nail on an animal's foot
a jointed gripping part on a crab or similar animal
to scratch or pull at something with claws or fingers

ex.en: The cat caught my sleeve with one sharp claw.
ex.zh: 猫用一只尖爪钩住了我的袖子。

ex.en: Sharp claws help many predators catch prey, while other animals use them to climb or dig.
ex.zh: 锋利的爪子帮助许多捕食者捕获猎物，而其他动物则用爪子攀爬或挖掘。

col: claw at something｜使劲抓挠某物
words.tip: claw是尖爪；paw指猫狗等动物的整个脚掌。

senses.en: the early morning when daylight first appears
the beginning of a new period or development
to become understood, or to begin growing light

ex.en: We left at dawn to avoid the heavy traffic.
ex.zh: 我们黎明时就出发了，以避开拥堵的交通。

ex.en: The dawn of digital communication has transformed how people maintain relationships across national borders.
ex.zh: 数字通信时代的到来改变了人们跨国维系人际关系的方式。

col: from dawn to dusk｜从早到晚
the dawn of a new era｜新时代的开端
dawn on someone｜使某人开始明白
words.tip: It dawned on me that…表示“我开始明白……”。

senses.en: Allowing light through so objects behind can be seen clearly.
Open and clear about decisions, actions, or methods.
Easy to recognise or understand, especially as false.

ex.en: She keeps her buttons in a transparent plastic box.
ex.zh: 她把纽扣放在一个透明塑料盒里。

ex.en: Public institutions need transparent recruitment procedures to ensure fairness and maintain the trust of local communities.
ex.zh: 公共机构需要公开透明的招聘程序，以确保公平并维持当地社区的信任。

col: transparent excuse｜一眼就能识破的借口
words.tip: 透明强调看得清；translucent指透光但看不清。

senses.en: The way parents care for and teach a child

ex.en: Her upbringing taught her to share with others.
ex.zh: 她从小受到的家庭教育让她懂得与人分享。

ex.en: A supportive upbringing can help children develop confidence and cope more effectively with challenges at school.
ex.zh: 充满支持的家庭养育有助于孩子建立自信，更有效地应对学校里的挑战。

col: a strict upbringing｜严格的家庭教育
a sheltered upbringing｜备受呵护的成长经历
a privileged upbringing｜优越的成长环境
words.tip: 指童年养育及家庭教育，不等同于学校教育。

senses.en: The scientific study of the mind and behaviour.
The characteristic ways a person or group thinks and behaves.

ex.en: My sister studies psychology and hopes to help children.
ex.zh: 我姐姐学习心理学，希望将来帮助儿童。

ex.en: Research in psychology suggests that regular social interaction can support emotional wellbeing among older adults.
ex.zh: 心理学研究表明，经常进行社交互动有助于维护老年人的情绪健康。

words.tip: 开头的p不发音；psychologist指心理学家。

senses.en: A unit measuring heat energy or energy supplied by food.

ex.en: I do not count every calory in my lunch.
ex.zh: 我不会计算午餐里的每一卡路里。

ex.en: Although calory intake matters, public health advice should also consider nutritional quality and access to fresh food.
ex.zh: 虽然热量摄入很重要，但公共卫生建议也应考虑营养质量以及新鲜食物的可获得性。

words.tip: calory是罕用变体；现代写作请用calorie。

senses.en: a title introducing a section within a longer piece

ex.en: This subheading helps me find the recipe's cooking instructions.
ex.zh: 这个小标题帮我找到了食谱中的烹饪步骤。

ex.en: Each subheading in a research report should clearly indicate the focus of the following section.
ex.zh: 研究报告中的每个小标题都应明确指出其后部分的重点。

words.tip: 指文章内部的分标题，不指影视字幕。

senses.en: An amount that can be held in one hand.
A small number of people or things.
Someone or something that is difficult to manage.

ex.en: He sprinkled a handful of nuts over his breakfast.
ex.zh: 他在早餐上撒了一把坚果。

ex.en: Only a handful of rural communities have reliable public transport, limiting residents' access to employment and healthcare.
ex.zh: 只有少数农村社区拥有可靠的公共交通，这限制了居民获得就业机会和医疗服务。

words.tip: a handful of可接不可数名词或复数名词。

senses.en: to obtain something from a particular source
to come or develop from something else

ex.en: I derive great pleasure from growing vegetables on my balcony.
ex.zh: 在阳台上种菜让我获得很大的乐趣。

ex.en: Many coastal communities derive a significant proportion of their income from tourism and fishing.
ex.zh: 许多沿海社区的收入有很大一部分来自旅游业和渔业。

words.tip: derive A from B指从B获得A；derive from指源于。

senses.en: Sharing a situation, activity, or status with someone
A man or boy, referred to informally
A member of a learned society or certain academic institutions

ex.en: I shared my umbrella with a fellow passenger.
ex.zh: 我和一位同行的乘客共撑了一把伞。

ex.en: Students who regularly exchange ideas with fellow learners often develop greater confidence and stronger communication skills.
ex.zh: 经常与同学交流想法的学生往往能增强自信，提高沟通能力。

words.tip: 形容词只放名词前，如my fellow students。

senses.en: To fall or let liquid fall in separate drops.
A small drop of liquid, or the sound it makes.
Equipment that slowly delivers liquid into a patient's vein.

ex.en: Water dripped from my umbrella onto the kitchen floor.
ex.zh: 水从我的伞上滴到了厨房地板上。

ex.en: Leaking pipes can drip continuously, wasting substantial amounts of water in cities with ageing infrastructure.
ex.zh: 漏水的管道可能不断滴水，使基础设施老化的城市浪费大量水资源。

col: a dripping tap｜滴水的水龙头
put someone on a drip｜给某人输液
words.tip: 英式英语用 on a drip 表示正在输液。

senses.en: Having little depth from the surface to the bottom
Lacking serious thought, understanding, or emotional depth
Taking only a small amount of air into the lungs

ex.en: The children splashed happily in the shallow end of the pool.
ex.zh: 孩子们在泳池浅水区开心地戏水。

ex.en: Shallow coastal waters provide important habitats for young fish, making their protection essential for sustainable fisheries.
ex.zh: 浅海沿岸水域为幼鱼提供重要栖息地，因此保护这些水域对渔业的可持续发展至关重要。

words.tip: 水浅或思想肤浅都可用shallow，反义词为deep。

senses.en: to close and open one eye quickly as a signal
a quick closing and opening of one eye as a signal

ex.en: My sister winked at me across the dinner table.
ex.zh: 姐姐隔着餐桌朝我眨了一只眼。

ex.en: A friendly wink may communicate shared understanding, although its meaning can vary considerably across different cultures.
ex.zh: 友善的眨眼可能传达彼此的默契，但其含义在不同文化间可能有很大差异。

col: give someone a wink｜向某人眨眼示意
not sleep a wink｜一夜没合眼
words.tip: wink常指单眼示意；blink指自然眨眼。

senses.en: to eat growing grass, or let animals feed on it
to scrape skin slightly or touch something while passing
a small injury where skin has been scraped off

ex.en: Sheep graze quietly beside the river every summer morning.
ex.zh: 每个夏日清晨，羊群都在河边安静地吃草。

ex.en: Allowing cattle to graze too intensively can damage vegetation and increase the risk of soil erosion.
ex.zh: 让牛群过度放牧会破坏植被，并增加水土流失的风险。

words.tip: 动物吃草可说graze on grass；graze cattle指放牛。

senses.en: To become visible or known after being hidden.
To develop or become important and noticeable.

ex.en: A small rabbit emerged from beneath the garden shed.
ex.zh: 一只小兔子从花园棚屋底下钻了出来。

ex.en: New employment opportunities may emerge as governments invest more heavily in renewable energy infrastructure.
ex.zh: 随着政府加大对可再生能源基础设施的投资，新的就业机会可能会出现。

col: emerge as a leader｜崭露头角成为领导者
words.tip: 不及物动词；常用emerge from或emerge as。

senses.en: Not believing or acting as though you are better than others.
Simple or low in social position, wealth, or importance.
To make someone feel less proud or important.

ex.en: Despite winning the prize, she remained humble and thanked everyone.
ex.zh: 尽管获了奖，她依然谦逊，并向所有人表示感谢。

ex.en: Effective leaders remain humble enough to acknowledge mistakes and learn from colleagues with different backgrounds and experiences.
ex.zh: 优秀的领导者保持谦逊，愿意承认错误，并向背景和经历不同的同事学习。

col: in my humble opinion｜依我拙见
words.tip: 谦逊是humble；不要与“羞辱”humiliate混淆。

senses.en: The work of organising and running an institution or business.
The people responsible for managing a government or organisation.
The act of giving medicine or treatment to someone.

ex.en: She handles the administration for our local sports club.
ex.zh: 她负责我们当地体育俱乐部的行政工作。

ex.en: Efficient administration allows public hospitals to allocate resources fairly and respond more quickly to patients' needs.
ex.zh: 高效的行政管理使公立医院能够公平分配资源，更快地回应患者需求。

words.tip: 指管理工作时通常不可数；指一届政府时可数。

senses.en: a condition involving dependence on alcohol and difficulty controlling drinking

ex.en: The clinic offers confidential support for people with alcoholism.
ex.zh: 这家诊所为有酒精依赖问题的人提供保密的支持服务。

ex.en: Effective treatment for alcoholism often combines medical care, psychological support, and help from family members.
ex.zh: 有效治疗酒精依赖通常需要结合医疗护理、心理支持和家人的帮助。

col: treatment for alcoholism｜酒精依赖的治疗
recover from alcoholism｜从酒精依赖中康复
words.tip: 指酒精依赖这一疾病，不指嗜酒的人。

senses.en: feeling that something good is likely to happen
suggesting that a good result is likely
someone hoping to succeed in a competition or particular career

ex.en: She felt hopeful after her first successful driving lesson.
ex.zh: 第一次驾驶课上得很顺利，她感到充满希望。

ex.en: Scientists remain hopeful that improved battery technology will make renewable energy more reliable and affordable.
ex.zh: 科学家仍抱有希望，认为电池技术的改进将使可再生能源更加可靠且价格更亲民。

col: hopeful about the future｜对未来充满希望
a hopeful sign｜令人看到希望的迹象
words.tip: 人满怀希望用hopeful；事物有前景常用promising。

senses.en: A woodwind instrument with a single reed and finger-operated keys.

ex.en: My sister practises the clarinet quietly after dinner.
ex.zh: 我姐姐晚饭后轻声练习单簧管。

ex.en: Learning to play the clarinet can help children develop concentration while encouraging participation in school orchestras.
ex.zh: 学习吹奏单簧管能帮助儿童培养专注力，同时鼓励他们参加学校管弦乐团。

col: a clarinet player｜单簧管演奏者
words.tip: 演奏乐器通常说play the clarinet，注意加the。

senses.en: a bird often associated with peace
someone who favours peaceful solutions rather than military action

ex.en: A white dove landed gently on our garden wall.
ex.zh: 一只白鸽轻轻落在我们花园的围墙上。

ex.en: Political doves argue that international disputes should be resolved through negotiation rather than military intervention.
ex.zh: 政治上的主和派认为，国际争端应通过谈判而非军事干预解决。

col: a symbol of peace｜和平的象征
a political dove｜政治上的主和派人士
words.tip: 指主和派时，与主张强硬手段的hawk相对。

senses.en: giving satisfaction or a sense of achievement
providing substantial financial benefits

ex.en: Teaching my little cousin to swim was surprisingly rewarding.
ex.zh: 教我的小表弟游泳，出乎意料地让我很有成就感。

ex.en: Volunteering can be a rewarding experience that develops practical skills and strengthens connections within local communities.
ex.zh: 志愿服务可以是一段有意义的经历，既能培养实用技能，也能加强当地社区内部的联系。

words.tip: 多指带来满足感；强调赚钱可加financially。

senses.en: To order someone not to do something or disallow it

ex.en: Our building rules forbid leaving bicycles in the hallway.
ex.zh: 我们楼的规定禁止将自行车停放在走廊里。

ex.en: Governments should forbid companies from releasing untreated waste into rivers to protect public health and aquatic ecosystems.
ex.zh: 政府应禁止企业将未经处理的废弃物排入河流，以保护公众健康和水生生态系统。

col: forbid someone to do something｜禁止某人做某事
forbid someone from doing something｜禁止某人做某事
words.tip: 过去式forbade，过去分词forbidden；可接动名词。

senses.en: Better in quality or performance than another
Someone with a higher position or rank than you
Behaving as though you are better than other people

ex.en: These boots offer superior grip on wet paths.
ex.zh: 这双靴子在湿滑小路上的防滑性能更好。

ex.en: Public transport can provide a superior alternative to private cars when services are frequent and reliable.
ex.zh: 当班次密集且服务可靠时，公共交通可以成为比私家车更好的出行选择。

words.tip: 比较时用superior to，不用superior than。

senses.en: a feeling of very great surprise

ex.en: He stared in astonishment as the tiny seedling flowered.
ex.zh: 看到小小的幼苗开花了，他惊讶地瞪大了眼睛。

ex.en: The speed of technological change often causes astonishment, particularly among people who remember life before widespread internet access.
ex.zh: 技术变革的速度常令人惊叹，尤其是那些还记得互联网普及前生活的人。

col: to someone's astonishment｜令某人惊讶的是
words.tip: 通常不可数；to one's astonishment表示令某人惊讶的是。

senses.en: An escape of liquid or gas, or an opening allowing it.
To let liquid or gas escape through a hole or crack.
To reveal private information without permission.

ex.en: A leak under the sink soaked all our cleaning cloths.
ex.zh: 水槽下方的漏水把我们所有的清洁布都浸湿了。

ex.en: Water companies should repair leaks promptly to conserve resources and reduce unnecessary pressure on local supplies.
ex.zh: 供水公司应及时修复漏水处，以节约资源并减轻当地供水的不必要压力。

col: leak confidential information｜泄露机密信息
words.tip: leak 可作名词或动词，也可指秘密信息泄露。

senses.en: A change made to improve something or suit a purpose.

ex.en: This small modification makes the chair much more comfortable.
ex.zh: 这处小改动让椅子舒服多了。

ex.en: Modification of existing buildings can reduce energy consumption without the environmental costs of new construction.
ex.zh: 改造现有建筑可以降低能耗，同时避免新建工程带来的环境代价。

words.tip: 可数时指具体改动，不可数时指修改过程。

senses.en: a sale where an item goes to the highest bidder
to sell something to the person offering the most money

ex.en: My aunt bought this old clock at an auction.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在一次拍卖会上买下了这座旧钟。

ex.en: Charities often auction donated artwork to raise funds for educational programmes in communities with limited resources.
ex.zh: 慈善机构常拍卖获捐的艺术品，为资源匮乏社区的教育项目筹款。

words.tip: at auction可不加冠词；auction off表示拍卖掉。

senses.en: The flat cutting part of a knife or tool.
A flat part that rotates to move air or water.
A long narrow leaf of grass.

ex.en: The knife's blade was too blunt to slice tomatoes.
ex.zh: 这把刀的刀刃太钝，切不动番茄。

ex.en: Each blade of a wind turbine is designed to capture energy efficiently from moving air.
ex.zh: 风力涡轮机的每片叶片都经过专门设计，以高效获取流动空气中的能量。

col: a blade of grass｜一片草叶
words.tip: blade指刀的切割部分，knife指整把刀。

senses.en: Unwilling to change your opinion or behaviour.
Difficult to remove, treat, or deal with.

ex.en: My stubborn brother refused to wear a coat outside.
ex.zh: 我那固执的弟弟不肯穿外套出门。

ex.en: Stubborn resistance to change can prevent organisations from adopting more efficient and environmentally responsible practices.
ex.zh: 顽固地抵制变革可能使机构无法采用更高效、更环保的做法。

words.tip: 形容人多含贬义；也可形容顽渍或难治的病。

senses.en: Strong protective covering worn in battle or fitted to vehicles.
Military vehicles with protective covering, considered as a group.

ex.en: The museum displayed a knight's armour beside a wooden shield.
ex.zh: 博物馆在一面木盾旁展出了一套骑士盔甲。

ex.en: Surviving examples of medieval armour reveal how metalworking skills developed in response to changing military needs.
ex.zh: 现存的中世纪盔甲展示了金属加工技术如何随着军事需求的变化而发展。

col: a suit of armour｜一套盔甲
words.tip: 英式armour，美式armor；通常不可数。

senses.en: An informal word for a dollar.
A male deer, rabbit, or certain other animals.
For a horse to jump with its back arched.

ex.en: I bought this warm scarf for just five bucks.
ex.zh: 我只花了五美元就买到了这条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Although shoppers may save a few bucks online, local retailers often provide more personalised advice and support.
ex.zh: 虽然网上购物可能让顾客省下几美元，但本地零售商往往提供更贴心的建议和帮助。

col: make a quick buck｜快速捞钱
words.tip: 表示美元时属口语；pass the buck意为推卸责任。

senses.en: deliberately inflicted severe pain, or an extremely distressing experience
to deliberately cause severe physical or mental suffering

ex.en: Waiting all afternoon for the results was pure torture.
ex.zh: 整个下午都在等结果，真是煎熬。

ex.en: International agreements prohibit torture and require governments to protect the basic rights of all prisoners.
ex.zh: 国际协议禁止酷刑，并要求各国政府保护所有囚犯的基本权利。

col: subject someone to torture｜使某人遭受酷刑
words.tip: 语气很强；日常可夸张表达煎熬，不只是普通不适。

senses.en: enough to meet a need or achieve a purpose

ex.en: We have sufficient food for everyone at the picnic.
ex.zh: 我们准备了足够的食物，供参加野餐的每个人享用。

ex.en: Without sufficient funding, local authorities may struggle to maintain essential services for their growing populations.
ex.zh: 如果资金不足，地方政府可能难以为不断增长的人口维持基本服务。

words.tip: 常用sufficient for或sufficient to do，语气较正式。

senses.en: a small soluble case containing medicine that you swallow
a small enclosed compartment carrying people or equipment in space

ex.en: The pharmacist told me to swallow the capsule with water.
ex.zh: 药剂师告诉我要用水吞服这粒胶囊。

ex.en: The space capsule was designed to protect its crew from extreme temperatures during their return to Earth.
ex.zh: 这艘太空舱的设计旨在保护乘员，使其返回地球时免受极端高温的伤害。

words.tip: 药物capsule有外壳；tablet通常是压制成的药片。

senses.en: The ability to understand something, especially language or ideas.

ex.en: Drawing a simple diagram helped my comprehension of the instructions.
ex.zh: 画一张简单的图帮助我理解了操作说明。

ex.en: Regular exposure to varied reading materials can improve students' comprehension and expand their academic vocabulary.
ex.zh: 经常接触多样的阅读材料可以提高学生的理解力，并扩充其学术词汇。

words.tip: 通常不可数；comprehensive意为“全面的”。

senses.en: a short memorable phrase promoting an idea, group, or product

ex.en: Our club chose a catchy slogan for its recycling campaign.
ex.zh: 我们社团为回收利用活动选了一句朗朗上口的口号。

ex.en: An effective environmental slogan can attract attention, but lasting behavioural change usually requires practical support.
ex.zh: 有效的环保口号能够吸引注意，但持久的行为改变通常需要实际支持。

words.tip: slogan用于宣传；motto多指座右铭或行为准则。

senses.en: wanting more money or possessions than one needs
wanting to eat more food than one needs

ex.en: Don't be greedy; leave some biscuits for your sister.
ex.zh: 别贪吃，给你妹妹留些饼干。

ex.en: Greedy investors may prioritise immediate profits over the long-term environmental consequences of their business decisions.
ex.zh: 贪婪的投资者可能优先考虑眼前利润，而忽视商业决策的长期环境后果。

col: a greedy investor｜贪婪的投资者
words.tip: 常含贬义；greedy for后接金钱、权力等所贪之物。

senses.en: A house or other place where someone lives.
The state or period of living in a particular place.

ex.en: Their new residence overlooks a quiet garden near the river.
ex.zh: 他们的新居俯瞰着河边一座安静的花园。

ex.en: Applicants may need to provide proof of residence before they can access certain local services.
ex.zh: 申请人可能需要提供居住证明，才能使用某些地方服务。

words.tip: residence较正式；居民是resident，住宅区用residential。

senses.en: A large room used for formal social dancing

ex.en: Couples glided across the ballroom beneath a sparkling chandelier.
ex.zh: 一对对舞伴在闪亮的枝形吊灯下滑过舞厅。

ex.en: Restoring the historic ballroom could attract visitors while providing local residents with a valuable space for cultural events.
ex.zh: 修复这座历史悠久的舞厅可以吸引游客，同时为当地居民提供宝贵的文化活动场所。

words.tip: ballroom dancing 指交谊舞，不是夜店蹦迪。

senses.en: Protected from direct sunlight.
Made darker with colour or drawn marks.

ex.en: We found a shaded bench beneath an old tree.
ex.zh: 我们在一棵老树下找到了一张背阴的长椅。

ex.en: Providing shaded areas in public parks encourages outdoor activity during hot weather and reduces heat exposure.
ex.zh: 在公园提供遮阴区域，有助于鼓励人们在炎热天气进行户外活动，并减少高温暴露。

col: shaded area｜遮阴区域；阴影区域
words.tip: 也可作shade的过去式或过去分词，表示遮挡阳光。

senses.en: A large, strong bag used for storing or carrying things.
To dismiss someone from their job.
Dismissal from a job, used in the phrase the sack.

ex.en: We carried a heavy sack of potatoes into the kitchen.
ex.zh: 我们把一大袋沉甸甸的土豆搬进厨房。

ex.en: Employers should not sack workers without explaining the reasons and allowing them to challenge the decision.
ex.zh: 雇主不应在未说明理由、未允许员工提出异议的情况下解雇他们。

col: a sack of potatoes｜一大袋土豆
sack someone for misconduct｜因行为不当解雇某人
words.tip: 表示解雇时常用于英式口语；正式用dismiss。

senses.en: The spiritual part of a person, separate from the body.
A person, especially when describing their character.
Expressive popular music combining gospel and rhythm and blues.

ex.en: Walking beside the sea always seems to soothe my soul.
ex.zh: 在海边散步似乎总能抚慰我的心灵。

ex.en: Many cultural traditions view the soul as something that continues to exist after the body dies.
ex.zh: 许多文化传统认为，灵魂在肉体死亡后仍然存在。

col: a kind soul｜心地善良的人
not a soul｜一个人也没有
words.tip: not a soul意为一个人也没有，不是没有灵魂。

senses.en: A solid whose particles form a regular, repeating pattern.
Clear quartz used in jewellery and decorative objects.

senses.zh: 水晶玻璃；水晶玻璃制品
senses.en: High-quality glass, or objects made from it.

ex.en: We examined a salt crystal under the classroom microscope.
ex.zh: 我们用教室里的显微镜观察了一颗盐晶体。

ex.en: The structure of a crystal influences its physical properties and determines its suitability for various industrial applications.
ex.zh: 晶体结构影响其物理性质，并决定它是否适合各种工业用途。

col: crystal clear｜清澈透明的；十分清楚的
words.tip: crystal clear既可形容水清澈，也可表示意思十分清楚。

senses.en: to choose someone for a position by voting
to choose to do something

ex.en: Our club elected a new captain last night.
ex.zh: 我们俱乐部昨晚选出了一位新队长。

ex.en: Citizens should elect representatives who are willing to address long-term environmental challenges rather than seek immediate popularity.
ex.zh: 公民应当选举愿意应对长期环境挑战的代表，而不是追求眼前人气的人。

col: elect someone to office｜选举某人任职
elect to do something｜选择做某事
words.tip: elect sb chair 中职务前常不加冠词。

senses.en: Available in large amounts, often more than needed.

ex.en: Fresh fruit is abundant here during the summer.
ex.zh: 这里夏天有充足的新鲜水果。

ex.en: Regions with abundant sunlight have considerable potential to generate affordable electricity from solar energy.
ex.zh: 阳光充足的地区具有利用太阳能生产廉价电力的巨大潜力。

col: abundant wildlife｜丰富的野生动植物
words.tip: abundant强调数量充足；名词搭配an abundance of。

senses.en: In or to a position directly below something.
Considered too low in status or value for someone.
In or to a lower position.

ex.en: Our cat slept beneath the table during dinner.
ex.zh: 我们吃晚饭时，猫在桌子下面睡觉。

ex.en: Beneath the city's busy streets, an extensive railway network allows residents to travel efficiently.
ex.zh: 在这座城市繁忙的街道下，庞大的铁路网络让居民能够高效出行。

words.tip: 比under更正式；beneath也可表示有失身份。

senses.en: To put more weight or work on something than manageable.
To make an electrical circuit carry more current than safe.

ex.en: Don't overload your backpack with things you won't use.
ex.zh: 别把用不上的东西塞进背包，让它变得太重。

ex.en: Schools should avoid overloading students with homework, as excessive pressure can undermine motivation and wellbeing.
ex.zh: 学校应避免让学生承担过重的作业负担，因为过度的压力会削弱学习动力并损害身心健康。

col: overload someone with work｜给某人过多工作
words.tip: 常用overload someone with something。

senses.en: to tolerate something unpleasant or carry a heavy responsibility
a large, heavily built mammal with thick fur
to have or display a particular feature or mark

ex.en: I can't bear the noise of that old fan.
ex.zh: 我受不了那台旧风扇的噪声。

ex.en: Low-income households often bear the greatest burden when the cost of essential goods rises.
ex.zh: 生活必需品价格上涨时，低收入家庭往往承受最沉重的负担。

words.tip: 过去式bore；过去分词通常borne；出生用born。

senses.en: not boasting about your abilities or achievements
not large in size, amount, or cost
wearing clothes that do not reveal much of the body

ex.en: Despite winning the race, she remained modest about her success.
ex.zh: 尽管赢了比赛，她谈起自己的成功时仍很谦虚。

ex.en: Even a modest increase in public transport funding could improve services in rural communities.
ex.zh: 即使公共交通拨款只小幅增加，也可能改善农村社区的服务。

col: modest about one's achievements｜对自己的成就谦虚
words.tip: 形容人常指谦虚；形容数量常指不大。

senses.en: Made a device or process start working.
Treated to increase chemical activity or ability to absorb substances.

ex.en: The moving cat activated the light above our door.
ex.zh: 那只走动的猫触发了我们门上的感应灯。

ex.en: The emergency warning system was activated immediately after sensors detected unusual movement beneath the ocean.
ex.zh: 传感器检测到海底异常运动后，紧急预警系统立即启动。

words.tip: 是activate的过去式和过去分词；不表示性格活泼。

senses.en: The visible features of an area of land.
The overall conditions and features of a particular field.
To improve land by arranging plants and other outdoor features.

ex.en: Snow covered the landscape beyond our small wooden cabin.
ex.zh: 白雪覆盖了我们小木屋外的山野。

ex.en: Large wind farms can alter the rural landscape, although they provide an important source of clean energy.
ex.zh: 大型风电场虽然是重要的清洁能源来源，却可能改变乡村景观。

words.tip: landscape可数，指一片景观；scenery通常不可数。

senses.en: Magnetic tape used to record moving images and sound.
To record moving images and sound onto magnetic tape.

ex.en: We found an old videotape of our family picnic.
ex.zh: 我们找到了一盘记录家庭野餐的旧录像带。

ex.en: Libraries can preserve recordings stored on videotape by converting them into digital formats for future generations.
ex.zh: 图书馆可以将录像带上的影像转成数字格式，为后代保存这些记录。

col: an old videotape｜一盘旧录像带
videotape a performance｜用录像带录制演出
words.tip: 指磁带录像；现代数字录像通常用video或record。

senses.en: A boat designed or adapted for people to live in.

ex.en: We spent the weekend on a houseboat beside the riverbank.
ex.zh: 我们在河岸边的一艘船屋上度过了周末。

ex.en: Living on a houseboat may offer affordable accommodation, although maintenance costs and mooring fees can be substantial.
ex.zh: 住在船屋上或许能降低居住开支，但维护成本和停泊费可能相当高。

col: live on a houseboat｜住在船屋上
rent a houseboat｜租一艘居住船
words.tip: 指供人居住的船，不等于用于娱乐的游艇。

senses.en: A small motorcycle with a low-powered engine, sometimes with pedals

ex.en: She parked her moped beside the bakery this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早上，她把轻便摩托车停在面包店旁边。

ex.en: A moped can offer affordable transport for short journeys, although riders remain vulnerable on busy urban roads.
ex.zh: 轻便摩托车可以为短途出行提供经济的交通方式，不过骑行者在繁忙的城市道路上仍易受伤害。

col: ride a moped｜骑轻便摩托车
rent a moped｜租轻便摩托车
words.tip: 名词读两音节；mope的过去式moped读作/məʊpt/。

senses.en: Having no hope, or offering no chance of success.
Very bad at doing something.

ex.en: The situation seemed hopeless until our neighbours offered help.
ex.zh: 直到邻居们伸出援手，情况才不再显得毫无希望。

ex.en: Students who feel hopeless about their academic progress may benefit from individual guidance and achievable learning goals.
ex.zh: 对学业进步感到绝望的学生可能会受益于个别指导和可实现的学习目标。

col: hopeless at cooking｜极不擅长做饭
a hopeless case｜无可救药的人或事
words.tip: “不擅长做某事”用hopeless at doing。

senses.en: Having a name that is unknown or kept secret.
Lacking distinctive features that make something easy to recognize.

ex.en: An anonymous donor paid for the children's new playground.
ex.zh: 一位匿名捐赠者出资为孩子们建了新游乐场。

ex.en: Anonymous surveys can encourage employees to express honest opinions about conditions in their workplace.
ex.zh: 匿名调查能鼓励员工坦诚表达对工作环境的看法。

words.tip: 匿名是anonymous；保密是confidential，含义不同。

senses.en: A person or country that supports another.
To join with someone for a shared purpose.

ex.en: My neighbour became an ally in saving the park.
ex.zh: 在保护公园这件事上，我的邻居成了我的盟友。

ex.en: Local charities can be valuable allies for governments seeking to reduce poverty and improve social inclusion.
ex.zh: 对于致力于减贫和促进社会包容的政府而言，当地慈善机构可以成为重要盟友。

words.tip: 名词重音通常在前；动词通常读/əˈlaɪ/。

senses.en: A person who is not a member of the armed forces
Relating to people or activities outside the armed forces

ex.en: The rescue boat carried both soldiers and civilians.
ex.zh: 救援船上既有军人，也有平民。

ex.en: Satellite technology originally developed for military purposes now supports many civilian applications, including weather forecasting and navigation.
ex.zh: 最初为军事目的开发的卫星技术，如今支持天气预报和导航等多种民用应用。

words.tip: civilian指非军人；公务员通常是civil servant。

senses.en: Telling the truth or accurately describing what happened.

ex.en: Please be truthful about how the vase broke.
ex.zh: 请如实说说花瓶是怎么打碎的。

ex.en: Truthful reporting helps citizens understand public issues and make informed decisions about their communities.
ex.zh: 如实报道有助于公民理解公共议题，并就社区事务作出明智决定。

col: be truthful about something｜如实说明某事
words.tip: truthful指诚实或如实；“真正的朋友”用true。

senses.en: a school where students live as well as study

ex.en: Amir shares a room with two friends at boarding school.
ex.zh: 阿米尔在寄宿学校与两个朋友同住一间房。

ex.en: Attending boarding school can foster independence, although some children find prolonged separation from their families difficult.
ex.zh: 就读寄宿学校可以培养独立性，但有些孩子觉得长期与家人分离很难适应。

col: attend boarding school｜就读寄宿学校
send a child to boarding school｜送孩子去寄宿学校
words.tip: boarding指食宿；寄宿学校既提供教学也提供住宿。

senses.en: having little chance of harm, loss, or failure

ex.en: We chose a low-risk investment for our savings.
ex.zh: 我们为储蓄选择了一项低风险投资。

ex.en: Low-risk financial products may appeal to households that prioritise stability over potentially higher returns.
ex.zh: 低风险金融产品可能吸引那些更重视稳定而非潜在高回报的家庭。

words.tip: low-risk表示风险较低，不等于完全无风险。

senses.en: to move faster or make something happen more quickly

ex.en: The bus accelerated as it left the village.
ex.zh: 公共汽车驶离村庄时加快了速度。

ex.en: Investment in public transport can accelerate the transition towards cleaner and more efficient urban travel.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以加快向更清洁、更高效的城市出行方式转型。

words.tip: 既可指车辆加速，也可指进程加快；可及物或不及物。

senses.en: not producing the result that is wanted

ex.en: This tiny fan is ineffective in such a large room.
ex.zh: 这个小风扇在这么大的房间里起不了作用。

ex.en: Awareness campaigns may be ineffective unless governments also provide affordable alternatives to environmentally harmful products.
ex.zh: 如果政府不同时提供价格可负担的环保替代品，宣传活动可能难以奏效。

words.tip: ineffective指无效果；inefficient指效率低。

senses.en: A narrow bed, often arranged above or below another.

ex.en: I climbed into the top bunk and fell asleep.
ex.zh: 我爬上上铺，睡着了。

ex.en: Providing each passenger with a comfortable bunk could make overnight trains more attractive than short flights.
ex.zh: 为每位乘客提供舒适的铺位，能让夜间列车比短途航班更有吸引力。

words.tip: top bunk是上铺；bunk bed指双层床。

senses.en: work, especially physical work, or the workers who perform it
to work hard, often with considerable physical effort
the process of giving birth to a baby

ex.en: Repairing the old fence took a full day of labor.
ex.zh: 修理那道旧围栏花了整整一天的工夫。

ex.en: Investment in automation can reduce labor costs, but governments must help displaced workers develop new skills.
ex.zh: 投资自动化可以降低劳动力成本，但政府必须帮助失业工人培养新技能。

words.tip: labor为美式拼写，英式作labour。

senses.en: Too willing to trust because of limited experience.

ex.en: I was naive to believe the repair would cost nothing.
ex.zh: 我竟以为维修不用花钱，真是太天真了。

ex.en: It would be naive to assume that economic growth alone can solve every social problem.
ex.zh: 认为单靠经济增长就能解决所有社会问题，是不切实际的。

words.tip: 常含缺乏经验、容易轻信之意，并非单纯褒义。

senses.en: to become larger or make something larger
to add more details to an explanation or discussion

ex.en: The dough expanded as it rested in the warm kitchen.
ex.zh: 面团在温暖的厨房里静置时膨胀起来了。

ex.en: Universities should expand access to online courses while ensuring that disadvantaged students have adequate equipment and internet connections.
ex.zh: 大学应扩大在线课程的覆盖范围，同时确保弱势学生拥有足够的设备和网络条件。

col: expand access to｜扩大获得……的机会
expand on an idea｜进一步阐述想法
words.tip: “详述”用expand on/upon；扩大某物可直接接宾语。

senses.en: Discuss terms with others to reach an agreement.
Successfully move past an obstacle or along a difficult route.

ex.en: We negotiated a lower price for the secondhand sofa.
ex.zh: 我们经过协商，以更低的价格买下了那张二手沙发。

ex.en: Governments must negotiate fair trade agreements that protect workers while encouraging international investment and economic growth.
ex.zh: 各国政府必须协商达成公平的贸易协定，在保护劳动者的同时促进国际投资和经济增长。

col: negotiate an agreement｜协商达成协议
negotiate a bend｜顺利通过弯道
words.tip: 与某人谈判用with；也可直接接agreement。

senses.en: soldiers collectively, or an organized military unit
an organized group of people or a group of animals
to walk somewhere together as a group

ex.en: Troops helped local families cross the river after the flood.
ex.zh: 洪水过后，士兵们帮助当地家庭渡过河流。

ex.en: Governments sometimes deploy troops to deliver emergency supplies when natural disasters make civilian transport systems unusable.
ex.zh: 当自然灾害导致民用运输系统无法使用时，政府有时会派遣部队运送应急物资。

col: a troop of monkeys｜一群猴子
words.tip: 表示士兵常用复数troops；演员团用troupe。

senses.en: Continuing regularly without sudden changes.
Firmly controlled, balanced, or calm.
Make something stable or bring it under control.

ex.en: Keep a steady pace as you climb the hill.
ex.zh: 上山时保持平稳的步速。

ex.en: Steady investment in public transport can improve urban mobility and reduce traffic congestion over time.
ex.zh: 持续稳定地投资公共交通，可以逐步改善城市出行并缓解交通拥堵。

words.tip: steady作形容词；修饰动词通常用steadily。

senses.en: relating to volume measured in cubes, or shaped like a cube

ex.en: Our new water tank holds two cubic metres.
ex.zh: 我们的新水箱能容纳两立方米的水。

ex.en: Modern irrigation systems can save thousands of cubic metres of water each year.
ex.zh: 现代灌溉系统每年可以节约数千立方米的水。

words.tip: cubic用于体积单位；square用于面积单位。

senses.en: a man with a high noble rank or historical authority
a title used to address or refer to God

ex.en: The guide showed us where the local lord once lived.
ex.zh: 导游带我们看了当地领主曾经居住的地方。

ex.en: In medieval society, a lord often controlled farmland and collected payments from the people who worked it.
ex.zh: 在中世纪社会，领主往往控制着农田，并向耕种者收取费用。

col: a powerful lord｜有权势的领主
lord of the manor｜庄园领主
lord it over someone｜对某人作威作福
words.tip: 指上帝用the Lord；置于姓名前作头衔也大写。

senses.en: a place people visit for holidays and leisure
to use something undesirable because other options have failed
an option used when other choices are unavailable

ex.en: We stayed at a quiet resort beside the lake.
ex.zh: 我们住在湖边一处安静的度假村。

ex.en: Governments should not resort to cutting education budgets when seeking solutions to short-term financial problems.
ex.zh: 政府在寻求短期财政问题的解决办法时，不应采取削减教育预算的措施。

col: as a last resort｜作为最后的办法
words.tip: resort to中to是介词，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A written promise to repair or replace faulty goods within conditions.

ex.en: The shop repaired my camera because it was under warranty.
ex.zh: 因为相机还在保修期内，商店为我修好了它。

ex.en: A longer warranty may encourage consumers to choose durable appliances rather than cheaper products that require frequent replacement.
ex.zh: 更长的保修期可能促使消费者选择耐用电器，而不是需要频繁更换的廉价产品。

col: a manufacturer's warranty｜制造商保修承诺
words.tip: 在保修期内用under warranty，不用in warranty。

senses.en: To put someone or something in contact with an influence
To reveal something hidden, especially wrongdoing
To uncover something previously hidden or protected

ex.en: Don't expose your skin to strong sunlight without protection.
ex.zh: 不要在没有防护的情况下让皮肤暴露在强烈阳光下。

ex.en: Investigative journalism can expose unsafe working conditions and pressure companies to improve their treatment of employees.
ex.zh: 调查报道能够揭露不安全的工作条件，并向企业施压，促使其改善员工待遇。

col: expose someone to risk｜使某人面临风险
expose children to music｜让儿童接触音乐
words.tip: expose A to B表示使A接触B，B不一定有害。

senses.en: a lack of knowledge or awareness about something

ex.en: My ignorance of local customs led to an awkward moment.
ex.zh: 我不了解当地习俗，因此一度陷入尴尬。

ex.en: Public education can reduce ignorance about nutrition and help families make healthier choices on limited budgets.
ex.zh: 公众教育可以减少营养知识盲区，帮助家庭在预算有限的情况下作出更健康的选择。

col: in ignorance of｜在不知……的情况下
words.tip: 不可数；常用ignorance of/about表示对某事不了解。

senses.en: someone who owns a bank or holds a senior banking position

ex.en: The banker explained our loan options over coffee.
ex.zh: 那位银行经理边喝咖啡边向我们解释贷款方案。

ex.en: Bankers play an important role in assessing financial risks before approving loans to small businesses.
ex.zh: 银行高级职员在批准小企业贷款前评估财务风险，发挥着重要作用。

words.tip: 通常指银行家或高级职员，不泛指银行柜员。

senses.en: A warm feeling of love or fondness for someone or something.

ex.en: Our cat shows affection by rubbing against our legs.
ex.zh: 我们家的猫会蹭我们的腿来表达亲昵。

ex.en: Children who receive consistent affection from caregivers often develop greater emotional security and stronger social relationships.
ex.zh: 持续得到照护者关爱的儿童，往往会形成更强的情感安全感和更稳固的社会关系。

col: deep affection for｜对……的深厚感情
a sign of affection｜喜爱的表示
words.tip: 通常不可数；对某人的喜爱用affection for。

senses.en: a person's general attitude towards life or a situation
the likely future situation
the view from a particular place

ex.en: Despite recent difficulties, Lina maintains a cheerful outlook.
ex.zh: 尽管最近遇到困难，莉娜仍保持乐观的心态。

ex.en: Studying abroad can broaden students' outlook by exposing them to unfamiliar customs and different ways of thinking.
ex.zh: 留学能让学生接触不熟悉的习俗和不同的思维方式，从而拓宽他们的视野。

words.tip: 态度常接on；前景常接for，如outlook for growth。

senses.en: A car, especially in American English

ex.en: He took his car to an auto repair shop.
ex.zh: 他把车送到了一家汽车修理店。

ex.en: The auto industry faces growing pressure to produce affordable electric vehicles and reduce its environmental impact.
ex.zh: 汽车行业面临越来越大的压力，需要生产价格亲民的电动汽车并减少环境影响。

words.tip: 主要用于美式英语，常作定语，如auto industry。

senses.en: Walk quietly on your toes with your heels raised.

ex.en: She tiptoed past the bedroom to avoid waking her brother.
ex.zh: 她踮着脚尖走过卧室，以免吵醒弟弟。

ex.en: Visitors often tiptoe through historic buildings, although quiet conversation is usually permitted in these spaces.
ex.zh: 游客常常在历史建筑内踮脚轻走，尽管这些场所通常允许轻声交谈。

words.tip: 动词过去式为tiptoed；on tiptoe表示踮脚。

senses.en: a sign suggesting that something exists or may happen

ex.en: Those dark clouds are an indication of approaching rain.
ex.zh: 那些乌云是即将下雨的迹象。

ex.en: Rising demand for public transport provides an indication that urban travel habits are changing.
ex.zh: 公共交通需求的上升表明，城市居民的出行习惯正在改变。

col: give an indication of｜显示出……的迹象
words.tip: 常用 indication of sth 或 indication that 从句。

senses.en: A small green plant growing in soft patches on damp surfaces.

ex.en: Thick green moss covered the stones beside the stream.
ex.zh: 溪边的石头上覆盖着厚厚的绿色苔藓。

ex.en: Moss helps forest ecosystems retain moisture and provides a habitat for many tiny organisms.
ex.zh: 苔藓有助于森林生态系统保持水分，并为许多微小生物提供栖息地。

col: a patch of moss｜一片苔藓
words.tip: 常作不可数名词；lichen指地衣，不等于moss。

senses.en: The act of agreeing to receive or do something offered.
Willingness to welcome someone or regard something as suitable.
Recognition that a situation is real and must be faced.

ex.en: Her acceptance of the invitation made us all smile.
ex.zh: 她接受了邀请，我们都露出了笑容。

ex.en: Public acceptance of renewable energy projects often increases when local communities share in the economic benefits.
ex.zh: 当当地社区能够分享经济收益时，公众对可再生能源项目的认可度往往会提高。

col: acceptance of an offer｜接受提议
words.tip: 通常不可数；acceptance of后接接受的事物。

senses.en: Weapons and military equipment.
The body parts extending from the shoulders to the hands.

ex.en: The museum displays old arms behind thick glass.
ex.zh: 博物馆把古老的武器陈列在厚玻璃后面。

ex.en: International agreements can restrict the trade in arms and encourage governments to resolve disputes peacefully.
ex.zh: 国际协议可以限制武器贸易，并鼓励各国政府和平解决争端。

words.tip: 表示武器时用复数arms；an arm通常指一条手臂。

senses.en: A general rise in prices that reduces money's purchasing power.
The process of filling something with air or gas.

ex.en: Inflation means our weekly shopping costs more now.
ex.zh: 通货膨胀意味着我们现在每周购物花的钱更多了。

ex.en: High inflation can reduce household purchasing power, particularly when wages fail to keep pace with rising prices.
ex.zh: 高通胀会削弱家庭购买力，尤其是在工资跟不上物价上涨时。

col: the rate of inflation｜通货膨胀率
keep pace with inflation｜跟上通胀
words.tip: 经济语境指物价普遍上涨，不只某件商品涨价。

senses.en: Someone who translates spoken or signed communication between languages.
A program that reads and executes code directly.

ex.en: An interpreter helped my grandmother speak to the doctor.
ex.zh: 一位口译员帮助我祖母与医生交流。

ex.en: Providing a qualified interpreter in hospitals can improve communication and reduce misunderstandings about treatment options.
ex.zh: 在医院配备合格的口译员能够改善沟通，减少对治疗方案的误解。

col: a qualified interpreter｜合格的口译员
a sign language interpreter｜手语翻译员
words.tip: interpreter 通常做口译；translator 通常做笔译。

senses.en: a long pole with a sharp point, used as a weapon
to push a pointed object into or through something

ex.en: An ancient spear stood behind glass in the museum.
ex.zh: 博物馆的玻璃展柜里立着一支古代长矛。

ex.en: The discovery of a wooden spear provides valuable evidence about the hunting techniques of early human communities.
ex.zh: 一支木矛的发现为研究早期人类群体的狩猎技术提供了宝贵证据。

col: spear a piece of food｜叉起一块食物
words.tip: spear是长矛，不是枪械；动词可指用叉子戳起食物。

senses.en: to cry with short, sudden breaths
a short, broken breath or sound made while crying

ex.en: The child began to sob after losing her toy.
ex.zh: 孩子丢了玩具后开始抽泣。

ex.en: Children may sob when separated from caregivers, so schools should provide gentle support during transitions.
ex.zh: 儿童与照顾者分开时可能会抽泣，因此学校应在适应阶段给予温和的支持。

words.tip: 过去式sobbed，进行式sobbing，均双写b。

senses.en: an early version of writing that may be changed
to write an early version of a document

ex.en: I saved the first draft of my letter.
ex.zh: 我保存了这封信的初稿。

ex.en: Governments should publish draft legislation early so that citizens can comment before final decisions are made.
ex.zh: 政府应尽早公布立法草案，让公民在最终决定作出前发表意见。

words.tip: 表“草稿”英美均用draft；穿堂风英式用draught。

senses.en: the total distance a vehicle has travelled
the distance a vehicle travels using a given amount of fuel
the usefulness or advantage gained from something

ex.en: This used car has surprisingly low mileage for its age.
ex.zh: 这辆二手车以它的车龄来说，行驶里程少得令人意外。

ex.en: Vehicles with better fuel mileage can lower household transport costs and reduce demand for fossil fuels.
ex.zh: 燃油行驶效率更高的车辆可以降低家庭交通开支，并减少对化石燃料的需求。

col: get mileage out of｜从……中获益
words.tip: low mileage指跑得少；good mileage通常指省油。

senses.en: either bone structure in the mouth that holds the teeth

ex.en: My jaw felt sore after chewing the hard bread.
ex.zh: 嚼完那块硬面包后，我的下颌有些酸痛。

ex.en: Protective equipment can reduce the risk of jaw injuries among people who participate in contact sports.
ex.zh: 防护装备可以降低接触性运动参与者颌部受伤的风险。

words.tip: jaw指颌骨或颌部；chin仅指脸部最下方的下巴。

senses.en: The back part of something.
Located at the back of something.
To care for children or animals until they grow up.

ex.en: We loaded the bags into the rear of the van.
ex.zh: 我们把包放进了货车后部。

ex.en: Farmers who rear animals outdoors must provide adequate shelter and maintain high standards of animal welfare.
ex.zh: 在户外饲养动物的农民必须提供足够的遮蔽场所，并维持较高的动物福利标准。

words.tip: at the rear of 表位置；rear animals 指饲养。

senses.en: Someone who avoids animal foods and usually other animal products.

senses.zh: 纯素的；不含动物制品的
senses.en: Using or containing no animal products.

ex.en: As a vegan, I cook with beans instead of meat.
ex.zh: 作为纯素食者，我用豆类代替肉来做饭。

ex.en: A carefully planned vegan diet can meet nutritional needs while reducing some environmental impacts of food production.
ex.zh: 精心规划的纯素饮食能够满足营养需求，同时减少食品生产带来的部分环境影响。

col: go vegan｜开始采用纯素生活方式
words.tip: vegan不吃蛋奶；vegetarian通常可吃蛋奶。

senses.en: Close something tightly to prevent anything entering or escaping
A covering or fastening that keeps something securely closed
A sea mammal with flippers that also rests on land

ex.en: Seal the jar tightly to keep the biscuits fresh.
ex.zh: 把罐子密封好，让饼干保持新鲜。

ex.en: Builders should seal gaps around windows to reduce heat loss and improve household energy efficiency.
ex.zh: 建筑工人应封住窗户周围的缝隙，以减少热量流失，提高家庭能源利用效率。

words.tip: 作动词强调封严；作名词也可指海豹，注意语境。

senses.en: to leave something out, deliberately or accidentally

ex.en: You can omit the chilli if you prefer milder soup.
ex.zh: 如果喜欢清淡些的汤，可以不放辣椒。

ex.en: Reports that omit important evidence may give policymakers an inaccurate picture of the challenges facing local communities.
ex.zh: 遗漏重要证据的报告，可能使政策制定者误判当地社区面临的挑战。

col: omit something from a report｜从报告中删去某项内容
words.tip: 过去式omitted，进行式omitting，均双写t。

senses.en: relating to farming, including growing crops and raising animals

ex.en: The museum displays agricultural tools used by local farmers.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了当地农民使用过的农具。

ex.en: Modern agricultural practices can increase food production, but excessive chemical use may damage soil and water quality.
ex.zh: 现代农业生产方式可以提高粮食产量，但过量使用化学品可能损害土壤和水质。

words.tip: 形容词，常修饰 land、production、machinery。

senses.en: The religion followed by Muslims, teaching belief in one God

ex.en: Our guide explained how Islam influences the mosque's design.
ex.zh: 导游解释了伊斯兰教如何影响这座清真寺的设计。

ex.en: Learning about Islam and other major religions can help students understand the traditions of diverse communities.
ex.zh: 学习伊斯兰教及其他主要宗教，有助于学生理解不同群体的传统。

col: the teachings of Islam｜伊斯兰教教义
the history of Islam｜伊斯兰教历史
convert to Islam｜皈依伊斯兰教
words.tip: Islam指宗教；Muslim指穆斯林或穆斯林的。

senses.en: To pull a vehicle or boat using another vehicle.
The act of pulling a vehicle or boat.

ex.en: A truck towed our broken car to the garage.
ex.zh: 一辆卡车把我们出故障的汽车拖到了修理厂。

ex.en: Local authorities may tow illegally parked vehicles to keep emergency access routes clear in crowded urban areas.
ex.zh: 地方当局可能会拖走违停车辆，以保持拥挤城区的应急通道畅通。

col: give someone a tow｜帮某人拖车
words.tip: 强调车辆或船只牵引；tow away常指拖走违停车辆。

senses.en: A person who oversees other people's work or activities.
An academic who guides a student's research.

ex.en: My supervisor showed me how to use the equipment.
ex.zh: 我的主管教我如何使用这些设备。

ex.en: A supportive supervisor can help new employees develop confidence and adapt to unfamiliar workplace expectations.
ex.zh: 支持员工的主管能帮助新员工建立信心，并适应不熟悉的工作要求。

words.tip: 职场中指主管；英国大学中也常指研究导师。

senses.en: Many times, often with little time between occasions.

ex.en: He knocked repeatedly, but nobody came to the door.
ex.zh: 他敲了好几次门，但没人来开门。

ex.en: Students who repeatedly practise retrieving information tend to remember it better than those who simply reread their notes.
ex.zh: 反复练习回忆信息的学生，通常比只是重读笔记的学生记得更牢。

words.tip: 强调次数多；不一定像regularly那样有规律。

senses.en: not right or appropriate for a particular person or purpose

ex.en: These thin shoes are unsuitable for walking through deep snow.
ex.zh: 这双薄鞋不适合在深雪中行走。

ex.en: Some traditional teaching methods are unsuitable for large classes because they offer limited opportunities for individual feedback.
ex.zh: 一些传统教学方法不适合大班教学，因为它们提供个别反馈的机会有限。

words.tip: 常用unsuitable for sb/sth，表示不适合某人或用途。

senses.en: In a way that shows approval, confidence, or optimism.
With certainty and no doubt.
Used to strongly emphasise a description.

ex.en: My sister reacted positively when I suggested a picnic.
ex.zh: 我提议去野餐时，姐姐欣然赞同。

ex.en: Students often respond positively to detailed feedback that recognises their progress and offers practical guidance.
ex.zh: 学生往往会积极回应既肯定进步又提供实用指导的详细反馈。

words.tip: positively可强调语气，也可表示积极态度或确定性。

senses.en: the connected events that make up a story
a small piece of land used for a particular purpose
secretly plan something harmful or dishonest

ex.en: The film had a simple but exciting plot.
ex.zh: 这部电影的情节简单却扣人心弦。

ex.en: Community gardens allow residents to grow vegetables on a small plot, improving access to fresh food.
ex.zh: 社区花园让居民可以在一小块土地上种菜，更方便地获得新鲜食物。

col: a plot of land｜一小块土地
a garden plot｜一小块菜园地
plot against someone｜密谋对付某人
words.tip: plot指情节；作动词还可表示标绘数据。

senses.en: the act of beginning to use an idea or method
the legal process of becoming a child's parent

ex.en: The adoption of online booking made appointments much easier.
ex.zh: 采用网上预约后，约时间方便多了。

ex.en: Wider adoption of renewable energy could reduce air pollution and create employment in rural communities.
ex.zh: 更广泛地采用可再生能源可以减少空气污染，并为农村社区创造就业机会。

words.tip: adoption是采用或收养；adaptation是适应或改编。

senses.en: Facts or signs that help establish whether something is true.
To show clearly that something exists or is true.

ex.en: The muddy footprints were evidence that someone had entered.
ex.zh: 泥脚印表明有人进来过。

ex.en: Governments should consider scientific evidence before introducing policies intended to improve public health outcomes.
ex.zh: 政府在推出旨在改善公共健康状况的政策前，应考虑科学证据。

words.tip: 作名词通常不可数：一项证据用a piece of evidence。

senses.en: a loop of thread holding fabric or a wound together
to join or repair something using a needle and thread
a sharp pain in your side, often during exercise

ex.en: A few neat stitches fixed the hole in my sleeve.
ex.zh: 整齐地缝上几针，我袖子上的破洞就补好了。

ex.en: Teaching students to stitch torn clothing could reduce textile waste and encourage more sustainable consumption habits.
ex.zh: 教学生缝补破损衣物可以减少纺织品浪费，并鼓励更可持续的消费习惯。

words.tip: get a stitch指运动时岔气，不是“缝一针”。

senses.en: mostly or to a great extent

ex.en: The beach was largely empty when we arrived.
ex.zh: 我们到达时，海滩上几乎没什么人。

ex.en: The success of public health campaigns depends largely on clear communication and widespread community trust.
ex.zh: 公共卫生宣传活动的成功很大程度上取决于清晰的沟通和广泛的社区信任。

col: remain largely unchanged｜基本保持不变
largely responsible for｜对……负主要责任
words.tip: 表示主要或大体上，不表示物体体积很大。

senses.en: Strong trust or confidence in someone or something.
Belief in a god, or a particular religious system.

ex.en: I have faith in your ability to fix this.
ex.zh: 我相信你有能力修好这个。

ex.en: Transparent decision-making can strengthen public faith in institutions and encourage greater participation in community affairs.
ex.zh: 透明的决策过程能够增强公众对机构的信任，并鼓励更多人参与社区事务。

col: in good faith｜真诚地；善意地
words.tip: 表示对某人或某事有信心，用have faith in。

senses.zh: 精力充沛的；充满活力的
senses.en: Having or showing plenty of energy and enthusiasm.

ex.en: Our energetic puppy chased a ball around the garden.
ex.zh: 我们那只精力旺盛的小狗在花园里追着球跑。

ex.en: Regular physical activity can help office workers feel more energetic and maintain concentration throughout the day.
ex.zh: 经常运动有助于办公室职员更有活力，并在一天中保持专注。

words.tip: energetic形容人或活动有活力；energy是名词。

senses.en: Extreme or severe, causing a major change

ex.en: We took drastic action and sold our second car.
ex.zh: 我们采取了大刀阔斧的措施，卖掉了家里的第二辆车。

ex.en: Drastic cuts to public transport funding could leave many low-income households without affordable access to essential services.
ex.zh: 大幅削减公共交通资金，可能让许多低收入家庭无法以可负担的费用获得基本服务。

words.tip: 强调程度大、影响强，不等于表示速度快的rapid。

senses.en: A weapon with a long blade and a handle.

ex.en: An ancient sword lay inside the museum's glass case.
ex.zh: 一把古剑陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

ex.en: The discovery of a decorated sword provides evidence of advanced metalworking skills in this ancient society.
ex.zh: 一把装饰精美的剑的发现，为这个古代社会拥有先进金属加工技术提供了证据。

words.tip: w不发音；双刃剑可比喻既有利又有弊的事物。

senses.en: To accept something unpleasant or unwanted without stopping it.
To withstand difficult conditions or substances without serious harm.

ex.en: I can tolerate noise, but not while studying.
ex.zh: 我可以忍受噪声，但学习时不行。

ex.en: Schools should not tolerate bullying, because every student deserves a safe and supportive learning environment.
ex.zh: 学校不应容忍欺凌，因为每个学生都应享有安全且充满支持的学习环境。

words.tip: 后接名词或动名词：tolerate doing，不接to do。

senses.en: To copy someone's actions, speech, or way of doing something
To make something look or behave like something else

ex.en: Our little sister loves to imitate animal sounds.
ex.zh: 我们的小妹妹喜欢模仿动物的叫声。

ex.en: Young children often imitate adult behaviour, so parents play an important role in developing healthy habits.
ex.zh: 幼儿经常模仿成年人的行为，因此父母在培养健康习惯方面发挥着重要作用。

words.tip: 直接接模仿的对象，不加介词：imitate someone。

senses.en: The recorded music, speech, and sounds accompanying a film or programme.

ex.en: I listened to the film's soundtrack on the bus.
ex.zh: 我在公交车上听了那部电影的原声音乐。

ex.en: A carefully chosen soundtrack can strengthen a documentary's emotional impact without distracting viewers from its central message.
ex.zh: 精心挑选的配乐可以增强纪录片的情感感染力，又不分散观众对核心信息的注意力。

col: an original soundtrack｜原创影视配乐
compose a soundtrack｜创作影视配乐
words.tip: 不仅指配乐，也可指含对白和音效的完整声轨。

senses.en: An injury involving damage to skin or other body tissue.
To injure someone's body, especially by damaging the skin.
To hurt someone's feelings deeply.

ex.en: The nurse gently cleaned the wound on my knee.
ex.zh: 护士轻轻清洗了我膝盖上的伤口。

ex.en: Access to clean water and basic medical supplies is essential for treating wounds and preventing infection.
ex.zh: 获得清洁用水和基本医疗用品，对处理伤口和预防感染至关重要。

col: wound someone's pride｜伤害某人的自尊
words.tip: 伤口读/wuːnd/；wind的过去式wound读/waʊnd/。

senses.en: To flow over the edge because a container is too full.
To contain more people or things than can comfortably fit.
Liquid or other contents that exceed the available space.

ex.en: The bath overflowed while I was answering the door.
ex.zh: 我去应门时，浴缸里的水溢了出来。

ex.en: During heavy rainfall, urban drains may overflow and carry polluted water into nearby rivers.
ex.zh: 暴雨期间，城市排水管道可能满溢，将污水带入附近河流。

words.tip: 动词重音在末音节，名词重音在首音节。

senses.en: An extremely strong feeling of fear.
Violence or threats used to frighten and control people.

ex.en: She woke in terror after dreaming about a falling lift.
ex.zh: 她梦见电梯坠落，惊恐地醒了过来。

ex.en: Responsible news reporting should inform the public about threats without spreading unnecessary terror among communities.
ex.zh: 负责任的新闻报道应向公众说明威胁，同时避免在社区中传播不必要的恐慌。

col: a campaign of terror｜一连串恐怖活动
words.tip: 表示强烈恐惧，程度比fear深；通常不可数。

senses.en: The act of giving or taking food.

ex.en: The puppies always get excited around feeding time.
ex.zh: 小狗们每到喂食时间就特别兴奋。

ex.en: Regular feeding of wild animals by tourists can alter their behaviour and increase their dependence on humans.
ex.zh: 游客经常给野生动物喂食，可能改变其行为，并增加它们对人类的依赖。

col: a feeding schedule｜喂养时间安排
words.tip: 既可作名词，也可作feed的现在分词。

senses.en: supporting new ideas and changes intended to improve society
happening or developing gradually over time
a person who supports social or political reform

ex.en: Our new manager has progressive ideas about flexible working.
ex.zh: 我们的新经理对弹性工作有进步的想法。

ex.en: Progressive education policies can promote equal opportunities by providing additional support for students from disadvantaged backgrounds.
ex.zh: 进步的教育政策可以为弱势背景的学生提供额外支持，从而促进机会平等。

words.tip: 既可指支持改革，也可指逐步发展，未必变好。

senses.en: A way of dealing with a task or problem.
To move nearer to someone or something.
To begin dealing with something or contact someone about it.

ex.en: We tried a different approach to training our puppy.
ex.zh: 我们试着用另一种方法训练小狗。

ex.en: A balanced approach to urban planning should consider both economic growth and the protection of green spaces.
ex.zh: 均衡的城市规划方法应兼顾经济增长和绿地保护。

col: an approach to learning｜学习方法
adopt an approach｜采用一种方法
approach a problem｜着手处理问题
approach someone for advice｜找某人征求建议
words.tip: 名词“方法”后用to加名词或动名词；动词后直接接宾语。

senses.en: The space between two lines or surfaces that meet.
A particular way of considering or presenting something.
To position something so that it slopes or faces sideways.

ex.en: Adjust the angle of your screen to reduce glare.
ex.zh: 调整屏幕角度以减少眩光。

ex.en: Examining housing shortages from an economic angle can reveal how planning restrictions influence property prices.
ex.zh: 从经济角度审视住房短缺，可以揭示规划限制如何影响房价。

col: from a different angle｜从不同角度
words.tip: angle 是角度；angel 才是天使，注意字母顺序。

senses.en: sometimes, but not often or regularly

ex.en: We occasionally buy fresh bread from the market.
ex.zh: 我们偶尔会在市场买新鲜面包。

ex.en: Employees who occasionally work from home may benefit from greater flexibility without losing regular contact with colleagues.
ex.zh: 偶尔在家办公的员工可以享有更大的灵活性，同时保持与同事的经常联系。

words.tip: 常放实义动词前、be动词后，也可放句首。

senses.en: Able to make people believe something or agree with you

ex.en: Her persuasive explanation finally convinced me to join the club.
ex.zh: 她那番有说服力的解释终于让我同意加入俱乐部。

ex.en: Public health campaigns need persuasive messages that encourage people to adopt healthier daily habits.
ex.zh: 公共健康宣传需要有说服力的信息，鼓励人们养成更健康的日常习惯。

col: persuasive speaker｜善于说服人的演讲者
words.tip: 通常形容论点或表达有说服力，不作名词。

senses.en: Having no useful purpose or chance of achieving anything.

ex.en: It is pointless to water plants during heavy rain.
ex.zh: 下大雨时给植物浇水是徒劳的。

ex.en: Some students consider examinations pointless when they test memorisation rather than practical understanding of a subject.
ex.zh: 当考试考查的是记忆而非对学科的实际理解时，一些学生认为考试毫无意义。

words.tip: 常用 it is pointless to do，表示做某事徒劳。

senses.en: To make or become tighter or more firmly fixed.
To make rules or controls stricter.

ex.en: Please tighten the lid before you shake the bottle.
ex.zh: 请先拧紧瓶盖，再摇瓶子。

ex.en: Governments should tighten safety regulations to ensure that all new housing meets acceptable standards of construction.
ex.zh: 政府应加强安全监管，确保所有新建住房达到合格的建筑标准。

words.tip: 可及物也可不及物：tighten a rope；the rope tightens。

senses.en: extremely important to the success or outcome of something
expressing disapproval or carefully judging strengths and weaknesses
so serious that someone may die or something may fail

ex.en: Your support was critical when I started my business.
ex.zh: 我创业时，你的支持至关重要。

ex.en: Access to clean water is critical to improving public health in rapidly growing urban communities.
ex.zh: 获得清洁用水对改善快速发展城市社区的公共卫生至关重要。

col: critical to success｜对成功至关重要
words.tip: critical of表示批评；critical to表示对……至关重要。

senses.zh: 小牛；某些大型动物的幼崽
senses.en: A young cow or another large mammal, such as an elephant.
The fleshy back part of the leg below the knee.

ex.en: The calf stayed close to its mother in the field.
ex.zh: 那头小牛在田野里紧紧跟着妈妈。

ex.en: Farmers must provide each calf with adequate nutrition and shelter to support healthy growth.
ex.zh: 农民必须为每头小牛提供充足的营养和遮蔽场所，以支持其健康生长。

col: a newborn calf｜刚出生的小牛
words.tip: 复数为calves；字母l不发音。

senses.en: not level, flat, or smooth
not equal or regular in amount, quality, or distribution

ex.en: Watch your step on the uneven stones outside.
ex.zh: 外面的石头高低不平，走路时要小心。

ex.en: Uneven access to digital technology can widen educational inequalities between urban and rural communities.
ex.zh: 获取数字技术的机会不均等，可能扩大城乡社区之间的教育差距。

words.tip: 奇数用odd，不用uneven；uneven强调不平或不均。

senses.en: A pause or delay caused by uncertainty or nervousness.

ex.en: After a moment of hesitation, Lina knocked on the door.
ex.zh: 犹豫片刻后，莉娜敲了敲门。

ex.en: Some students show hesitation when speaking a foreign language because they fear making mistakes in front of classmates.
ex.zh: 一些学生说外语时会迟疑，因为他们害怕在同学面前犯错。

col: have no hesitation in doing｜毫不犹豫地做
words.tip: 毫不犹豫做某事：have no hesitation in doing。

senses.en: A person or organisation that pays taxes.

ex.en: As a taxpayer, I want cleaner streets and safer parks.
ex.zh: 作为纳税人，我希望街道更干净，公园更安全。

ex.en: Public infrastructure projects should deliver lasting benefits to the taxpayers who finance them.
ex.zh: 公共基础设施项目应为出资的纳税人带来持久的益处。

col: at taxpayers' expense｜由纳税人承担费用
taxpayer funding｜纳税人提供的资金
words.tip: 通常指纳税的个人，也可指纳税机构。

senses.en: a company or person that transports people or goods

senses.zh: 病原体携带者；传播媒介
senses.en: a person or animal that carries and may spread disease
an object designed to hold something while it is carried

ex.en: The carrier delivered our new sofa this morning.
ex.zh: 运输公司今天早上送来了我们的新沙发。

ex.en: People can be carriers of certain infections without symptoms, making effective disease prevention more challenging.
ex.zh: 人们可能携带某些病原体却没有症状，这使有效预防疾病更具挑战性。

words.tip: 医学中carrier可能没有症状，但仍携带病原体。

senses.en: concerning right and wrong, or following accepted standards of goodness
a lesson about right and wrong learned from a story

ex.en: Returning the lost wallet was clearly the moral choice.
ex.zh: 归还丢失的钱包显然是合乎道德的选择。

ex.en: Companies have a moral responsibility to ensure that their suppliers provide safe working conditions.
ex.zh: 企业在道义上有责任确保其供应商提供安全的工作环境。

col: the moral of the story｜故事的寓意
words.tip: moral指道德；morale指士气，注意拼写区别。

senses.en: a tool or machine used to make holes
repeated practice of a skill or emergency procedure
to make holes with a tool or train through repetition

ex.en: I borrowed a drill to put up the shelf.
ex.zh: 我借了一把电钻来安装架子。

ex.en: Regular fire drills help students respond calmly during emergencies and identify the safest routes out of school buildings.
ex.zh: 定期消防演习帮助学生在紧急情况下冷静应对，并辨认出离开校舍的最安全路线。

words.tip: fire drill 是消防演习，不是灭火用的钻具。

senses.en: In a way that shows politeness and regard for others.

ex.en: The children listened respectfully while their grandfather shared memories.
ex.zh: 祖父讲述往事时，孩子们恭敬地听着。

ex.en: Students should learn to disagree respectfully with opposing views rather than dismissing them without careful consideration.
ex.zh: 学生应学会尊重地表达对相反观点的异议，而不是未经认真思考就否定它们。

col: respectfully disagree｜礼貌地表示不同意
treat someone respectfully｜尊重地对待某人
words.tip: 勿混respectively（分别地）；本词强调尊重。

senses.en: a building where club members meet and use shared facilities

ex.en: We left our tennis bags outside the clubhouse.
ex.zh: 我们把网球包放在了俱乐部会所外面。

ex.en: A shared clubhouse can strengthen community ties by giving local sports teams a place to meet regularly.
ex.zh: 共用会所为当地运动队提供定期聚会的场所，有助于加强社区联系。

col: golf clubhouse｜高尔夫俱乐部会所
words.tip: 指俱乐部使用的建筑，不指俱乐部这个组织。

senses.en: To surround something with a wall, fence, or other barrier.
To put something inside an envelope or package with something else.

ex.en: A low stone wall encloses our sunny back garden.
ex.zh: 一道低矮的石墙围着我们阳光充足的后花园。

ex.en: Applicants should enclose copies of their qualifications when submitting a paper application for the scholarship.
ex.zh: 申请人提交纸质奖学金申请时，应随附资格证明文件的复印件。

col: enclose a copy｜随函附上副本
words.tip: 纸质信件随附用enclose；邮件附件用attach。

senses.en: a scientist who studies stars, planets, and space

ex.en: The astronomer adjusted her telescope beneath the clear night sky.
ex.zh: 那位天文学家在晴朗的夜空下调整了望远镜。

ex.en: Astronomers use powerful telescopes to investigate distant galaxies and improve our understanding of how the universe developed.
ex.zh: 天文学家利用高性能望远镜研究遥远的星系，加深我们对宇宙演化过程的理解。

words.tip: astronomer研究天体；astrologer是占星师。

senses.en: Likely to change frequently or unexpectedly.

ex.en: Pack a light jacket because the weather is changeable.
ex.zh: 带上一件薄外套吧，因为天气多变。

ex.en: Farmers need reliable forecasts to plan their work effectively in regions with highly changeable weather.
ex.zh: 在天气高度多变的地区，农民需要可靠的预报来有效安排农活。

col: a changeable mood｜变化无常的情绪
words.tip: 常形容天气或情绪多变；注意保留change末尾的e。

senses.en: information or resources supplied to a system or process
ideas or advice contributed to a discussion or task
to enter information into a computer or other device

ex.en: Please input your address before choosing a delivery time.
ex.zh: 请选择配送时间前先输入地址。

ex.en: Community input can help planners design public spaces that better reflect local needs.
ex.zh: 居民的意见可以帮助规划者设计出更符合当地需求的公共空间。

words.tip: 作动词时，过去式可用 input 或 inputted。

senses.en: To travel regularly between home and work.
A regular journey between home and work.
To replace a legal punishment with a less severe one.

ex.en: I commute by train and usually read a book.
ex.zh: 我坐火车上下班，路上通常会看书。

ex.en: Employees who commute long distances may experience greater stress and have less time for family activities.
ex.zh: 长距离通勤的员工可能承受更大压力，陪伴家人的时间也更少。

words.tip: 通勤用 commute to work；减刑用 commute a sentence。

senses.en: A relationship in which changes in things are linked

ex.en: I noticed a correlation between late nights and headaches.
ex.zh: 我发现熬夜和头痛之间存在关联。

ex.en: A strong correlation between income and educational achievement does not necessarily mean that wealth directly causes academic success.
ex.zh: 收入与学业成绩高度相关，并不一定意味着财富直接带来学业成功。

words.tip: correlation不等于causation：相关不代表因果。

senses.en: Extremely dirty.
Offensive because of rude or sexual content.

ex.en: Your boots are filthy after that walk through the fields.
ex.zh: 你穿过田野走了一趟，靴子脏得不成样子。

ex.en: Filthy water supplies increase the risk of disease, particularly in communities without adequate sanitation infrastructure.
ex.zh: 肮脏的供水会增加患病风险，在缺乏完善卫生基础设施的社区尤其如此。

words.tip: 比dirty语气强，表示非常脏；也可形容言语下流。

senses.en: unnecessary excitement, worry, or activity about something
to worry or give excessive attention to small things

ex.en: Please don't make a fuss about a little mud.
ex.zh: 只是一点泥巴，别大惊小怪。

ex.en: Some parents fuss over minor mistakes, which may discourage children from trying unfamiliar activities.
ex.zh: 有些家长对小错误过分操心，这可能使孩子不敢尝试陌生的活动。

col: fuss over someone｜对某人过分关照
words.tip: make a fuss指大惊小怪；fuss over指过分操心。

senses.en: To explain or understand the meaning of something
To translate someone's speech into another language as they speak

ex.en: I interpreted her smile as permission to sit down.
ex.zh: 我把她的微笑理解为允许我坐下。

ex.en: Researchers must interpret survey results carefully because cultural differences may influence how participants understand the questions.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须谨慎解读调查结果，因为文化差异可能影响参与者对问题的理解。

col: interpret something as｜将某事理解为
words.tip: interpret可指口译；笔译通常用translate。

senses.en: The ability to read and write.
Basic knowledge and skills needed in a particular area.

ex.en: The library offers free literacy classes for local adults.
ex.zh: 图书馆为当地成年人提供免费的读写课程。

ex.en: Improving digital literacy helps older adults access essential services and participate more fully in modern society.
ex.zh: 提高数字素养有助于老年人获取必要服务，更充分地参与现代社会生活。

words.tip: 不可数；digital literacy指数字素养，不只是识字。

senses.en: to break, or make something break, into small pieces
to gradually lose strength, effectiveness, or power

ex.en: The dry biscuit crumbled as I picked it up.
ex.zh: 我拿起那块干饼干时，它碎了。

ex.en: Without regular maintenance, historic buildings may crumble, causing communities to lose an important part of their heritage.
ex.zh: 如果没有定期维护，历史建筑可能逐渐坍塌，使社区失去重要的文化遗产。

col: crumble under pressure｜在压力下崩溃
words.tip: 既可指实物碎裂，也可指信心、权力等崩溃。

senses.en: a crisp edible root, often small, red, and slightly spicy

ex.en: I sliced a crisp radish into our lunchtime salad.
ex.zh: 我把一个脆萝卜切成片，放进了午餐沙拉里。

ex.en: Growing radishes in school gardens allows children to observe plant development and learn about healthy eating.
ex.zh: 在学校菜园种萝卜能让孩子们观察植物生长，并了解健康饮食。

words.tip: 可数名词；常指红皮小萝卜，白萝卜可称daikon。

senses.en: To ask for information about something.

ex.en: I called the hotel to enquire about available rooms.
ex.zh: 我打电话给酒店，询问是否有空房。

ex.en: Prospective students should enquire about financial support before deciding which university course best suits their needs.
ex.zh: 有意申请的学生应先询问资助情况，再决定哪门大学课程最适合自己。

col: enquire into a matter｜调查某事
words.tip: 英式常用enquire，美式通常用inquire。

senses.en: an exceptionally fine work of art, literature, or skill

ex.en: Everyone stopped to admire the masterpiece above the fireplace.
ex.zh: 大家都停下来欣赏壁炉上方的那幅杰作。

ex.en: Displaying a masterpiece in a public museum allows people from different backgrounds to appreciate artistic achievement.
ex.zh: 在公共博物馆展出杰作，能让不同背景的人欣赏艺术成就。

words.tip: 通常指作品，不用来指才华出众的人。

senses.en: a child whose parents have both died
to cause a child to lose both parents through death

ex.en: The story follows an orphan living with her aunt.
ex.zh: 这个故事讲述了一个与姑姑生活的孤儿的经历。

ex.en: Children orphaned by natural disasters need stable care, emotional support, and continued access to education.
ex.zh: 因自然灾害成为孤儿的儿童需要稳定的照料、情感支持，以及继续接受教育的机会。

col: be orphaned at a young age｜幼年失去双亲
an orphaned child｜失去双亲的孩子
words.tip: 常用be orphaned表示因双亲去世而成为孤儿。

senses.en: existing only in the mind, not in reality

ex.en: The child poured tea for an imaginary friend.
ex.zh: 那个孩子给一位想象中的朋友倒了茶。

ex.en: Creating imaginary worlds through storytelling can help children develop creativity and explore unfamiliar social situations safely.
ex.zh: 通过讲故事创造想象中的世界，有助于儿童培养创造力，并安全地探索陌生的社交情境。

words.tip: imaginary指想象中的；imaginative指富有想象力的。

senses.en: Physical or mental pain experienced by people or animals.

ex.en: The medicine eased her suffering and helped her sleep.
ex.zh: 药物减轻了她的痛苦，让她得以入睡。

ex.en: Improving access to clean water can reduce human suffering in communities affected by prolonged drought.
ex.zh: 改善清洁用水的获取条件，可以减轻长期受干旱影响的社区居民的苦难。

words.tip: 泛指痛苦时通常不可数；sufferings指种种苦难。

senses.en: intended to be thrown away after use
available for spending or saving after taxes are paid

ex.en: We packed disposable plates for the picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们为湖边野餐带上了一次性盘子。

ex.en: Reducing the use of disposable packaging could significantly decrease the amount of waste sent to landfill.
ex.zh: 减少使用一次性包装可以显著减少送往垃圾填埋场的废弃物量。

words.tip: disposable income指税后收入，不是扣除生活费后的余额。

senses.en: A brownish metal made mainly from copper and tin.
A medal awarded for finishing third in a competition.
Made of bronze, or having its reddish-brown color.

ex.en: The small statue is made of solid bronze.
ex.zh: 这尊小雕像是用实心青铜制成的。

ex.en: Ancient tools made from bronze reveal how advances in metalworking transformed agriculture and trade across early societies.
ex.zh: 古代青铜工具揭示了金属加工技术的进步如何改变早期社会的农业和贸易。

words.tip: bronze是青铜；brass是黄铜；copper是铜。

senses.en: To try to find or obtain something.
To try to do or achieve something.

ex.en: You should seek advice before buying a used car.
ex.zh: 买二手车之前，你应该征求意见。

ex.en: Many graduates seek employment abroad to gain professional experience and develop their language skills.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生到国外求职，以积累职业经验并提升语言技能。

words.tip: 过去式和过去分词均为sought；后直接接宾语。

senses.en: An important victory or impressive achievement.
Great happiness and pride after achieving success.
To achieve victory or overcome a difficulty.

ex.en: Winning the local chess tournament was a triumph for Amir.
ex.zh: 赢得当地国际象棋锦标赛对阿米尔来说是一次重大胜利。

ex.en: The successful restoration of the wetland represents a triumph for conservation groups and local residents.
ex.zh: 湿地的成功修复是环保团体和当地居民取得的一项重大成果。

col: a sense of triumph｜胜利的喜悦
words.tip: 作动词时常用triumph over，表示战胜。

senses.en: in a way that achieves the intended result
in practice, although not officially or in every detail

ex.en: This simple brush cleans muddy shoes surprisingly effectively.
ex.zh: 这把简单的刷子清理沾泥的鞋子，效果出奇地好。

ex.en: Schools can reduce waste effectively by encouraging students to reuse materials during classroom activities.
ex.zh: 学校可以鼓励学生在课堂活动中重复使用材料，从而有效减少浪费。

words.tip: effectively侧重效果；efficiently侧重效率。

senses.en: To become bigger or make something bigger.

ex.en: Could you enlarge this photo so we can frame it?
ex.zh: 你能把这张照片放大，好让我们装框吗？

ex.en: The council plans to enlarge the public library to accommodate growing demand for quiet study spaces.
ex.zh: 市政委员会计划扩建公共图书馆，以满足对安静学习空间日益增长的需求。

col: enlarge on a point｜详述某一点
words.tip: enlarge指扩大；enlarge on指进一步详述。

senses.en: the bony structure of the head that protects the brain

ex.en: The museum displayed the skull of a large dinosaur.
ex.zh: 博物馆展出了一只大型恐龙的头骨。

ex.en: Wearing a properly fitted helmet helps protect the skull and brain during cycling accidents.
ex.zh: 骑行发生事故时，佩戴尺寸合适的头盔有助于保护颅骨和大脑。

col: the base of the skull｜颅底
words.tip: skull指头部骨骼，brain指内部的大脑。

senses.en: a tool used to open bottles, cans, or other containers
the first event or performance in a series
