ex.en: Teachers can use visual aids to make complex scientific concepts easier for younger students to understand.
ex.zh: 教师可以使用视觉教具，让年龄较小的学生更容易理解复杂的科学概念。

words.tip: visual表示与视觉有关；“栩栩如生”通常用vivid。

senses.en: to catch someone or something and prevent escape
to record an image, sound, or particular quality
the act of catching someone or something

ex.en: Rescuers captured the injured bird and gently examined its wing.
ex.zh: 救援人员捉住那只受伤的鸟，轻轻检查了它的翅膀。

ex.en: Wildlife researchers use remote cameras to capture animal behaviour without disturbing natural habitats.
ex.zh: 野生动物研究人员使用遥控摄像机记录动物行为，避免干扰自然栖息地。

words.tip: 拍摄影像、捕捉气氛也可用capture。

senses.en: a separate unit within a larger course of study
a separate part of a machine, system, or software

ex.en: We finished the photography module with an outdoor project.
ex.zh: 我们以一个户外项目完成了摄影单元的学习。

ex.en: Universities increasingly offer a compulsory module on digital skills to prepare students for changing workplace demands.
ex.zh: 越来越多的大学开设数字技能必修模块，以帮助学生应对不断变化的职场需求。

col: complete a module｜完成一个课程单元
words.tip: 课程中的module是独立单元，通常包含多节课。

senses.en: A tendency to become angry, or an angry mood.
Make something less strong, extreme, or severe.
Treat metal with heat to give it suitable hardness and toughness.

ex.en: He lost his temper when the drawer jammed again.
ex.zh: 抽屉又卡住了，他大发脾气。

ex.en: Governments should temper enthusiasm for new technologies with careful consideration of their potential social consequences.
ex.zh: 政府应认真考虑新技术可能带来的社会后果，避免一味热衷于推广。

col: temper enthusiasm with caution｜以谨慎节制热情
words.tip: lose your temper 是发脾气；动词常用 temper A with B。

senses.zh: 会说两种语言的；双语的
senses.en: Able to use two languages, or involving two languages.

senses.zh: 熟练使用两种语言的人
senses.en: Someone who can use two languages fluently.

ex.en: Our bilingual neighbour speaks both English and Chinese fluently.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居精通双语，英语和中文都说得很流利。

ex.en: Bilingual education can help children maintain their cultural identity while developing skills for an increasingly connected world.
ex.zh: 双语教育有助于孩子保持文化认同，同时培养适应日益互联世界所需的技能。

words.tip: 表示精通哪两种语言，可用bilingual in A and B。

senses.en: unwanted involvement in someone else's affairs or decisions
an action or influence that disrupts an activity or process
unwanted signals that reduce the quality of electronic reception

ex.en: I wanted to choose my clothes without anyone's interference.
ex.zh: 我想自己挑选衣服，不受任何人干涉。

ex.en: Universities need protection from political interference to ensure that research findings remain independent and credible.
ex.zh: 大学需要免受政治干预，以确保研究成果保持独立和可信。

col: interference in domestic affairs｜干涉内政
interference with sleep｜对睡眠的干扰
words.tip: in多接事务指干涉；with多接活动指妨碍。

senses.en: to become less strong, or make something less strong

ex.en: Too little sleep can weaken your ability to concentrate.
ex.zh: 睡眠不足会削弱你的专注能力。

ex.en: Persistent unemployment can weaken local economies by reducing household spending and discouraging business investment.
ex.zh: 持续失业会减少家庭支出并抑制企业投资，从而削弱地方经济。

col: weaken the immune system｜削弱免疫系统
weaken an argument｜削弱论点的说服力
words.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：使变弱或自身变弱。

senses.en: a wide street, often lined with trees
a possible way to achieve something or solve a problem

ex.en: We walked along a quiet avenue shaded by tall trees.
ex.zh: 我们沿着一条高树成荫的安静大道散步。

ex.en: Online learning offers an important avenue for adults seeking new skills while remaining in full-time employment.
ex.zh: 在线学习为希望在全职工作期间掌握新技能的成年人提供了一条重要途径。

col: explore every avenue｜探索一切途径
words.tip: 比喻义常见avenue for/of，表示途径。

senses.en: In most cases or on most occasions.
In a way that shows the usual qualities of something.

ex.en: Our neighbours typically walk their dog before breakfast.
ex.zh: 我们的邻居通常在早餐前遛狗。

ex.en: Cities with reliable public transport typically experience less traffic congestion than those dependent on private cars.
ex.zh: 公共交通可靠的城市通常比依赖私家车的城市交通拥堵更少。

words.tip: 通常放在实义动词前、be动词后。

senses.en: smooth, attractive movement or behaviour
extra time or kindness freely given
make a place or occasion more attractive by being present

ex.en: The dancer moved across the stage with effortless grace.
ex.zh: 那位舞者轻盈优雅地穿过舞台。

ex.en: A short grace period can help households manage unexpected delays in receiving their income.
ex.zh: 短暂的宽限期可以帮助家庭应对收入意外延迟到账的情况。

words.tip: grace 表优雅通常不可数；grace period 指宽限期。

senses.en: Likely to move, fall, or collapse.
Likely to change suddenly and unpredictably.

ex.en: This unstable chair wobbles whenever I sit on it.
ex.zh: 这把椅子不稳，我一坐上去就晃。

ex.en: An unstable economy can discourage investment and make long-term planning difficult for small businesses.
ex.zh: 经济不稳定会抑制投资，并使小企业难以制定长期计划。

words.tip: 可指物体不稳，也可指经济、局势等易变。

senses.en: Able to strongly affect people's opinions, decisions, or actions.

ex.en: Her grandfather was an influential teacher in their village.
ex.zh: 她的祖父曾是村里一位很有影响力的教师。

ex.en: Scientific advisers can be influential in shaping government policies on public health and environmental protection.
ex.zh: 科学顾问可以在制定公共卫生和环境保护政策方面发挥重要影响。

col: influential in shaping policy｜对政策制定有影响力
words.tip: 常用be influential in doing，表示对某事有影响。

senses.en: Willingness to give money, time, or help freely.
Willingness to be kind and forgiving towards others.

ex.en: Thanks to your generosity, everyone has a warm coat.
ex.zh: 多亏你的慷慨相助，每个人都有了一件暖和的外套。

ex.en: Community projects often depend on the generosity of residents who contribute both money and valuable practical skills.
ex.zh: 社区项目往往依靠居民的慷慨支持，他们既捐款，也贡献宝贵的实用技能。

col: an act of generosity｜慷慨之举
generosity towards others｜对他人的慷慨
words.tip: 通常不可数；一次慷慨之举用an act of generosity。

senses.en: A plant with large, often trumpet-shaped flowers.

ex.en: A white lily opened beside our kitchen window this morning.
ex.zh: 今天早晨，我们厨房窗边的一朵白百合开了。

ex.en: Urban gardens planted with lilies and other flowering species can provide attractive spaces for local residents.
ex.zh: 种有百合和其他开花植物的城市花园能为当地居民提供宜人的空间。

words.tip: 复数为lilies；water lily指睡莲。

senses.en: Having large, strong muscles.
Relating to the muscles of the body.

ex.en: The muscular swimmer lifted the heavy box easily.
ex.zh: 那位肌肉发达的游泳运动员轻松举起了沉重的箱子。

ex.en: Regular resistance training can improve muscular strength and help older adults maintain their independence.
ex.zh: 定期进行抗阻训练可以增强肌肉力量，帮助老年人保持独立生活的能力。

words.tip: 既可指肌肉发达，也可仅表示与肌肉有关。

senses.en: A child or young person.

ex.en: A cheerful youngster helped me pick up the apples.
ex.zh: 一个开朗的孩子帮我捡起了那些苹果。

ex.en: Community sports programmes give youngsters opportunities to develop teamwork skills and build friendships outside school.
ex.zh: 社区体育项目让青少年有机会培养团队协作能力，并在校外建立友谊。

col: a group of youngsters｜一群孩子
words.tip: 男女皆可指，语气较随意；正式写作可用young people。

senses.en: a very strong interest in someone or something

ex.en: She watched the tiny fish with fascination for hours.
ex.zh: 她着迷地看着那些小鱼，一看就是几个小时。

ex.en: Children's fascination with wildlife can provide a valuable starting point for environmental education in primary schools.
ex.zh: 孩子们对野生动物的浓厚兴趣，可以为小学环境教育提供宝贵的切入点。

col: hold a fascination for｜对……有吸引力
words.tip: 对某物着迷用 fascination with；看得入迷用 with fascination。

senses.en: A school or class for children beginning their education

ex.en: My daughter painted a bright yellow bird at kindergarten.
ex.zh: 我女儿在幼儿园画了一只鲜黄色的小鸟。

ex.en: High-quality kindergarten education can develop children's social skills and prepare them for more structured learning.
ex.zh: 优质的学前教育能培养儿童的社交能力，为更系统的学习做好准备。

words.tip: 美式常指小学前的一年；英式幼儿园常用nursery。

senses.en: A distinct period in a process of change or development.
One of the changing shapes of the moon as seen.
To introduce or remove something gradually in planned stages.

ex.en: The kitchen repairs have entered their final phase.
ex.zh: 厨房维修已进入最后阶段。

ex.en: During the initial phase of urban development, planners should prioritise affordable housing and reliable public transport.
ex.zh: 在城市发展的初期阶段，规划者应优先考虑可负担住房和可靠的公共交通。

col: a phase of development｜发展阶段
words.tip: phase in指逐步引入，phase out指逐步淘汰。

senses.en: a person who controls a machine or piece of equipment
a person or company that runs a business or service
a person who connects calls or provides telephone assistance

ex.en: The crane operator carefully lowered the beam into place.
ex.zh: 起重机操作员小心地把横梁降到指定位置。

ex.en: Every public transport operator should ensure that its services remain accessible to passengers with limited mobility.
ex.zh: 每家公共交通运营商都应确保行动不便的乘客能够使用其服务。

col: mobile network operator｜移动网络运营商
words.tip: 既指操作设备的人，也指经营服务的公司。

senses.en: Someone or something that causes great admiration or surprise
To feel great surprise or admiration

ex.en: We marvelled at the tiny bird's beautifully woven nest.
ex.zh: 那只小鸟精巧编织的巢让我们惊叹不已。

ex.en: The new bridge is an engineering marvel that connects isolated communities and improves access to essential services.
ex.zh: 这座新桥是一项工程奇迹，连接了偏远社区，并让居民更方便地获得基本服务。

col: a marvel of nature｜自然奇观
words.tip: 动词常接at；英式过去式marvelled，美式marveled。

senses.en: to use rude or offensive words
to make a serious promise or insist something is true

ex.en: Please don't swear when the game goes wrong.
ex.zh: 玩游戏不顺利时，请不要说脏话。

ex.en: Witnesses must swear to tell the truth before giving evidence in many legal systems.
ex.zh: 在许多法律体系中，证人作证前必须宣誓如实陈述。

col: swear to do something｜发誓做某事
words.tip: 过去式swore，过去分词sworn；swear at指咒骂。

senses.en: A short account presenting the main features of a subject.

ex.en: Our guide gave us an overview of the tour.
ex.zh: 导游向我们简要介绍了游览安排。

ex.en: The opening section provides an overview of the main challenges facing renewable energy development.
ex.zh: 开篇部分概述了可再生能源发展面临的主要挑战。

words.tip: 通常作可数名词；搭配an overview of。

senses.en: the process of finding people to join an organisation

ex.en: Our cafe handles recruitment before the busy summer season.
ex.zh: 我们咖啡馆会在繁忙的夏季到来之前招聘员工。

ex.en: Fair recruitment practices help employers attract talented applicants from a wide range of social backgrounds.
ex.zh: 公平的招聘方式有助于雇主吸引来自不同社会背景的优秀求职者。

words.tip: 通常不可数；招聘某类人员用recruitment of。

senses.en: Not very serious, important, or large.
A person younger than the legal age of adulthood.
Using a musical scale often associated with a sad sound.

ex.en: The bike only needs a few minor repairs.
ex.zh: 这辆自行车只需要稍作修理。

ex.en: Minor changes to daily travel habits can collectively reduce pollution in densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 日常出行习惯的小改变，累积起来可以减少人口密集城区的污染。

words.tip: minor injury指轻伤；名词a minor指未成年人。

senses.en: To examine facts carefully to discover what happened or why.
To study a subject carefully to learn more about it.

ex.en: A plumber came to investigate the strange noise upstairs.
ex.zh: 一位水管工来查明楼上怪声的原因。

ex.en: Researchers are investigating how access to green spaces affects the mental health of urban residents.
ex.zh: 研究人员正在探究接触绿地如何影响城市居民的心理健康。

words.tip: 直接接调查对象：investigate the problem，不加into。

senses.en: To make something clear through examples or evidence.
To provide pictures for a book or other publication.

ex.en: She used two jars to illustrate the difference.
ex.zh: 她用两个罐子来说明其中的区别。

ex.en: These findings illustrate how access to public transport can improve employment opportunities in disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 这些研究结果说明，公共交通的可及性如何改善弱势社区的就业机会。

col: illustrate a point｜说明一个观点
illustrate the importance of｜说明……的重要性
words.tip: illustrate可用例子说明，不一定涉及图片。

senses.en: Deserving great admiration or bringing honour and pride.
Extremely beautiful, enjoyable, or pleasant.

ex.en: We spent a glorious afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个美好的下午。

ex.en: Museums should examine difficult historical events as carefully as they celebrate a nation's glorious achievements.
ex.zh: 博物馆应像颂扬一个国家的辉煌成就一样，认真审视艰难的历史事件。

words.tip: glorious既可指值得荣耀，也可赞美天气或景色。

senses.en: A list of things to check or do

ex.en: I use a checklist when packing for a trip.
ex.zh: 旅行收拾行李时，我会用一份核对清单。

ex.en: A standard safety checklist can help hospital staff reduce avoidable errors during routine medical procedures.
ex.zh: 标准安全检查表能帮助医院工作人员减少常规医疗操作中可避免的错误。

words.tip: 可数名词；强调逐项核对，不只是罗列物品。

senses.en: easy to understand or do, without complications
honest and direct in expressing thoughts or intentions

ex.en: The recipe is straightforward, even for a beginner.
ex.zh: 这道食谱很简单，即使初学者也能照着做。

ex.en: Governments should make recycling procedures straightforward so that more households can participate without unnecessary confusion.
ex.zh: 政府应简化回收流程，让更多家庭能够参与，避免不必要的困惑。

col: a straightforward answer｜直截了当的回答
words.tip: 既可形容事情简单，也可形容人坦率。

senses.en: To rub skin with fingernails, often to relieve itching.
To damage a surface with something sharp or rough.
A thin mark or shallow injury caused by something sharp.

ex.en: Please don't scratch that bite; it will get worse.
ex.zh: 别挠那个被叮的包，会越挠越严重。

ex.en: Even a small scratch on a reusable container can make it harder to clean effectively.
ex.zh: 即使是可重复使用容器上的一道小划痕，也可能让它更难被彻底清洁。

words.tip: from scratch表示从零开始，与“抓挠”无关。

senses.en: a glass or plastic building that keeps growing plants warm

ex.en: We grow tomatoes in the greenhouse throughout the winter.
ex.zh: 整个冬天，我们都在温室里种番茄。

ex.en: Greenhouse cultivation can extend growing seasons, although heating these structures may require considerable amounts of energy.
ex.zh: 温室种植可以延长生长季，但为这些设施供暖可能需要消耗大量能源。

col: grow plants in a greenhouse｜在温室里种植物
greenhouse gas emissions｜温室气体排放
words.tip: greenhouse是名词，也可作定语，如greenhouse gases。

senses.en: The ability to achieve results without wasting time, energy, or resources

ex.en: Organising my tools improved the efficiency of my work.
ex.zh: 把工具整理好提高了我的工作效率。

ex.en: Improving energy efficiency in public buildings can reduce government spending and lower greenhouse gas emissions.
ex.zh: 提高公共建筑的能源利用效率，可以减少政府开支并降低温室气体排放。

words.tip: efficiency强调少浪费；effectiveness强调达到效果。

senses.zh: 有凝聚力的；紧密结合的
senses.en: united or closely connected as a whole

ex.en: Regular practice helped us become a more cohesive team.
ex.zh: 定期练习帮助我们成为一支更有凝聚力的队伍。

ex.en: Shared public spaces can help build cohesive communities by encouraging interaction among people from different backgrounds.
ex.zh: 共享公共空间可以促进不同背景的人交流，从而帮助建设有凝聚力的社区。

words.tip: cohesive强调紧密结合；coherent强调条理清楚。

senses.en: The main outer body of a ship or boat.
The outer covering of a seed or fruit.
To remove the outer covering or leafy top of food.

ex.en: We painted the boat's hull blue before launching it.
ex.zh: 我们把船体漆成蓝色，然后才将船下水。

ex.en: Improved hull designs can reduce fuel consumption by allowing ships to move through water with less resistance.
ex.zh: 改进船体设计可以减小船舶在水中航行的阻力，从而降低燃料消耗。

words.tip: 船体是hull；整艘船用ship或boat。

senses.en: a document describing a school or university for potential students

senses.zh: 招股说明书；项目介绍书
senses.en: a document explaining an investment or business opportunity

ex.en: I checked the college prospectus for photography courses.
ex.zh: 我查看了学院的招生简章，寻找摄影课程。

ex.en: A university prospectus should provide accurate information about tuition fees, course content, and available student support.
ex.zh: 大学招生简章应准确介绍学费、课程内容及可获得的学生支持服务。

col: request a prospectus｜索取招生简章
issue a prospectus｜发布招股说明书
words.tip: 教育语境常指招生简章，金融语境可指招股说明书。

senses.en: A fourteen-line poem following a particular rhyme and rhythm pattern.

ex.en: She read a sonnet aloud beside the open window.
ex.zh: 她在敞开的窗边朗读了一首十四行诗。

ex.en: Studying a sonnet helps students understand how formal constraints can encourage creative expression in literature.
ex.zh: 学习十四行诗有助于学生理解形式上的限制如何促进文学中的创造性表达。

words.tip: sonnet固定为十四行，但押韵格式不只一种。

senses.en: The education of boys and girls together in the same institution.

ex.en: My grandparents first experienced coeducation at their village school.
ex.zh: 我的祖父母在村里的学校首次接受了男女同校教育。

ex.en: Supporters of coeducation argue that learning together helps boys and girls develop mutual respect.
ex.zh: 支持男女同校教育的人认为，共同学习有助于男孩和女孩培养相互尊重的态度。

col: benefits of coeducation｜男女同校教育的益处
support coeducation｜支持男女同校教育
introduce coeducation｜实行男女同校教育
words.tip: 不可数名词；形容词形式为coeducational。

senses.en: An official abroad who assists citizens and represents national interests

ex.en: The consul helped us after we lost our passports.
ex.zh: 我们丢失护照后，领事给我们提供了帮助。

ex.en: A consul may support citizens facing difficulties overseas and help strengthen commercial links between countries.
ex.zh: 领事可以为在海外遇到困难的本国公民提供支持，并帮助加强国家间的商业联系。

words.tip: consul是领事；consulate是领事馆，勿混淆。

senses.en: Controlling people or situations unfairly for personal advantage.
Moving or adjusting something carefully, often using hands or tools.

ex.en: She recognised his emotional manipulation and refused to feel guilty.
ex.zh: 她识破了他的情感操控，拒绝为此感到内疚。

ex.en: The manipulation of survey results can mislead policymakers and reduce public trust in scientific research.
ex.zh: 操纵调查结果可能误导政策制定者，并降低公众对科学研究的信任。

col: data manipulation｜数据处理；数据篡改
words.tip: 指操控人时常含贬义；指操作工具时可中性。

senses.en: Happening or existing at the same time

ex.en: Two concurrent meetings meant I had to choose one.
ex.zh: 两个会议同时举行，我只能选择参加其中一个。

ex.en: Concurrent improvements in housing and public transport can make urban development more inclusive and sustainable.
ex.zh: 同步改善住房和公共交通，可以使城市发展更具包容性和可持续性。

words.tip: 强调时间重叠；表示“与…同时”可用concurrent with。

senses.en: Praise someone, often insincerely, to gain their favour.
Make someone feel pleased or honoured through attention or praise.
Make someone look more attractive than they otherwise would.

ex.en: That blue jacket really flatters you in this light.
ex.zh: 在这样的光线下，那件蓝色夹克真的很衬你。

ex.en: Advertisements often flatter consumers by suggesting that choosing a particular product demonstrates intelligence or good taste.
ex.zh: 广告常常暗示选择某种产品代表聪明或品位好，以此讨好消费者。

col: flatter someone's ego｜满足某人的虚荣心
words.tip: be flattered常指受宠若惊，不一定含贬义。

senses.en: Interfere in other people's affairs without being invited.

ex.en: Please don't meddle in how I arrange my room.
ex.zh: 请别干涉我如何布置自己的房间。

ex.en: Parents who constantly meddle in their children's decisions may prevent them from developing confidence and independence.
ex.zh: 不断干涉孩子决定的父母可能会阻碍他们培养自信和独立性。

col: meddle in someone's affairs｜干涉某人的私事
meddle with something｜擅自摆弄某物
words.tip: 常接in表示干涉事务；接with表示擅自摆弄。

senses.en: the act of thinking deeply and quietly about something
the act of considering a possible future action

ex.en: He sat by the lake in quiet contemplation.
ex.zh: 他坐在湖边，静静地沉思。

ex.en: Public gardens offer urban residents valuable opportunities for quiet contemplation away from the pressures of daily life.
ex.zh: 公共花园为城市居民提供宝贵的机会，让他们远离日常生活的压力，静心沉思。

words.tip: 通常不可数；强调安静深思，不一定是痛苦思索。

senses.en: the level at which something starts happening or changes
the bottom edge of a doorway
the point just before a new experience or period begins

ex.en: My brother has a much higher pain threshold than me.
ex.zh: 我哥哥比我耐疼得多。

ex.en: Raising the income threshold for financial assistance would allow more low-paid workers to receive support.
ex.zh: 提高经济援助的收入门槛，将使更多低薪劳动者能够获得支持。

col: on the threshold of｜即将进入
words.tip: on the threshold of表示即将进入某个新阶段。

senses.en: To be the parts that form a whole
To be considered a particular thing
To formally establish an organisation or governing body

ex.en: Vegetables constitute most of the food in our fridge.
ex.zh: 我们冰箱里的食物大部分是蔬菜。

ex.en: Rising housing costs constitute a major barrier to financial independence for young adults in large cities.
ex.zh: 不断上涨的住房成本构成了大城市年轻人实现经济独立的一大障碍。

col: constitute a committee｜正式成立委员会
words.tip: 表组成时通常以部分作主语，整体作宾语。

senses.en: Happening or provided before a surgical operation.

ex.en: The nurse explained my preoperative checks before tomorrow's surgery.
ex.zh: 护士向我解释了明天手术前要做的检查。

ex.en: Thorough preoperative assessment helps medical teams identify potential risks and plan appropriate care for each patient.
ex.zh: 全面的术前评估帮助医疗团队识别潜在风险，并为每位患者制定适当的护理计划。

words.tip: pre- 表示之前；postoperative 则表示手术后的。

senses.en: Existing as a natural or essential part of something.

ex.en: Even simple home repairs come with some inherent risks.
ex.zh: 即使是简单的家居维修也有一些固有风险。

ex.en: Policymakers must recognise the inherent limitations of economic growth as a measure of social progress and wellbeing.
ex.zh: 政策制定者必须认识到，用经济增长衡量社会进步和福祉存在固有局限。

words.tip: 常用inherent in；强调本身具有，而非后来获得。

senses.en: based on observation or experiments rather than theory alone

ex.en: Our garden trial provided empirical evidence that compost helps plants.
ex.zh: 我们的花园试验提供了堆肥有益植物的实证依据。

ex.en: Education policies should be supported by empirical research rather than assumptions about how children learn.
ex.zh: 教育政策应以实证研究为依据，而不是依赖对儿童学习方式的假设。

words.tip: 强调观察或实验依据，不等于个人经验之谈。

senses.en: An area beside a sea, lake, or river, especially in towns.

ex.en: We walked along the waterfront after an early dinner.
ex.zh: 我们早早吃完晚饭后沿着水岸散步。

ex.en: Redeveloping the waterfront can create attractive public spaces, provided that existing residents are not forced to leave.
ex.zh: 滨水区改造可以创造宜人的公共空间，前提是不迫使原有居民搬离。

words.tip: 指城镇临水地带，不一定是沙滩或海边。

senses.en: To share out or spread something again in a different way.

ex.en: We redistributed the blankets so everyone had one.
ex.zh: 我们重新分配了毯子，让每个人都有一条。

ex.en: Progressive taxation can redistribute wealth and help governments fund essential services for disadvantaged communities.
ex.zh: 累进税制能够重新分配财富，并帮助政府为弱势社区的基本服务提供资金。

words.tip: 强调改变原有分配，不一定意味着平均分配。

senses.en: the act of following a rule, law, or request

ex.en: The inspector checked our kitchen for compliance with hygiene rules.
ex.zh: 检查员查看了我们的厨房是否符合卫生规定。

ex.en: Regular inspections can improve compliance with environmental regulations and reduce pollution from industrial facilities.
ex.zh: 定期检查可以促进企业遵守环境法规，减少工业设施造成的污染。

words.tip: 通常不可数；表示遵守某规定时用compliance with。

senses.en: Not genuine, or intended to deceive people
Someone who pretends to be something they are not

ex.en: His phony smile disappeared as soon as we left.
ex.zh: 我们一走，他那虚假的笑容就消失了。

ex.en: Consumers should be cautious about phony online reviews that exaggerate the benefits of health products.
ex.zh: 消费者应警惕夸大保健产品功效的虚假网络评论。

words.tip: 偏口语；英式英语也常拼作phoney。

senses.en: with great care and attention to every detail

ex.en: She meticulously cleaned each tiny part of the watch.
ex.zh: 她一丝不苟地清洁手表的每个微小零件。

ex.en: Researchers must meticulously record their procedures so that other teams can reproduce and verify the results.
ex.zh: 研究人员必须细致记录操作步骤，以便其他团队复现并验证结果。

words.tip: 强调关注每个细节，不表示“胆小地”。

senses.en: shaped like a ball

ex.en: A spherical lamp hung above the dining table.
ex.zh: 餐桌上方挂着一盏球形灯。

ex.en: Researchers use spherical particles of different sizes to investigate how pollutants move through water filtration systems.
ex.zh: 研究人员使用大小不同的球形颗粒，研究污染物如何通过水过滤系统。

words.tip: spherical指立体球形；circular指平面圆形。

senses.en: A detailed description of how something must be designed or made.

ex.en: Check the specifications before buying a new laptop.
ex.zh: 买新笔记本电脑前，先查看规格参数。

ex.en: Clear building specifications help ensure that new housing meets safety standards and uses energy efficiently.
ex.zh: 明确的建筑技术要求有助于确保新住房符合安全标准并高效利用能源。

words.tip: 谈产品各项参数常用复数specifications，可简称specs。

senses.en: Very serious or intense.
Starting suddenly and lasting a short time, often severely.
Quick to notice or understand things.

ex.en: The village faced an acute water shortage last summer.
ex.zh: 去年夏天，这个村庄面临严重缺水。

ex.en: An acute shortage of affordable housing forces many young workers to live far from their workplaces.
ex.zh: 经济适用住房的严重短缺迫使许多年轻劳动者住在远离工作地点的地方。

words.tip: 疾病中acute与chronic（慢性的）相对。

senses.en: To allow fresh air to enter and circulate through somewhere.
To express or discuss opinions and concerns openly.

ex.en: Open both windows to ventilate the kitchen after cooking.
ex.zh: 做完饭后打开两扇窗，给厨房通风。

ex.en: Schools should ventilate classrooms regularly to improve indoor air quality and create healthier learning environments.
ex.zh: 学校应定期给教室通风，以改善室内空气质量，创造更健康的学习环境。

words.tip: 使通风是常用义；表示公开讨论时较正式。

senses.en: A small system showing the features of a larger one.

ex.en: Our busy kitchen is a microcosm of family life.
ex.zh: 我们忙碌的厨房是家庭生活的一个缩影。

ex.en: A diverse urban neighbourhood can serve as a microcosm of the wider society's opportunities and challenges.
ex.zh: 一个多元化的城市社区可以成为整个社会所面临的机遇与挑战的缩影。

col: a microcosm of society｜社会的缩影
serve as a microcosm｜充当缩影
words.tip: 常用a microcosm of，指缩影，不只是微小事物。

senses.en: Consideration of past events, often with a changed understanding.

ex.en: In retrospect, packing extra socks was a brilliant idea.
ex.zh: 现在回想起来，多带几双袜子真是个好主意。

ex.en: In retrospect, investing earlier in public transport could have prevented many of the city's current traffic problems.
ex.zh: 回过头看，如果早点投资公共交通，本可以避免这座城市目前的许多交通问题。

col: only in retrospect｜只有事后回想才
words.tip: 通常用于固定短语in retrospect，表示事后回想。

senses.en: make an action or process easier

ex.en: These sliding doors facilitate access for people using wheelchairs.
ex.zh: 这些推拉门方便使用轮椅的人进出。

ex.en: Digital platforms can facilitate collaboration between students in different countries, allowing them to exchange ideas more easily.
ex.zh: 数字平台可以促进不同国家学生之间的合作，让他们更容易交流想法。

words.tip: 后接名词或动名词，不用facilitate somebody to do。

senses.en: to happen again, especially repeatedly or after an interval

ex.en: If these headaches recur, please speak to your doctor.
ex.zh: 如果这些头痛再次出现，请咨询医生。

ex.en: Traffic congestion will continue to recur unless cities address the underlying causes of excessive car use.
ex.zh: 除非城市解决汽车使用过度的根本原因，否则交通拥堵将继续反复出现。

col: a recurring problem｜反复出现的问题
a recurring theme｜反复出现的主题
words.tip: 不及物动词；过去式recurred，分词recurring。

senses.en: to remove a ruler or government from power
the removal of a ruler or government from power

ex.en: The film follows citizens who overthrow an unfair ruler.
ex.zh: 这部电影讲述民众推翻不公正统治者的故事。

ex.en: Economic hardship can weaken public support for a government and encourage attempts to overthrow it.
ex.zh: 经济困难可能削弱公众对政府的支持，并促使人们尝试推翻它。

col: the overthrow of a ruler｜统治者被推翻
words.tip: 过去式overthrew，过去分词overthrown。

senses.en: a substance burned to produce a pleasant smell

ex.en: A thin trail of smoke rose from the incense.
ex.zh: 一缕轻烟从熏香上缓缓升起。

ex.en: Burning incense indoors can affect air quality, particularly in small rooms with inadequate ventilation.
ex.zh: 在室内焚香可能影响空气质量，尤其是在通风不足的小房间里。

words.tip: 名词重音在前；同形动词重音在后，意为激怒。

senses.en: Very unusual and unexpected
Someone extremely interested in a particular activity or subject
To become very frightened or upset, or make someone so

ex.en: A freak hailstorm covered our garden in white ice.
ex.zh: 一场罕见的冰雹把我们的花园盖上了一层白冰。

ex.en: A freak weather event can expose weaknesses in urban infrastructure and disrupt essential public services.
ex.zh: 异常天气事件可能暴露城市基础设施的薄弱环节，并扰乱基本公共服务。

col: a freak accident｜离奇的意外事故
a fitness freak｜健身狂热爱好者
words.tip: 形容词通常置于名词前；动词常用freak out。
words.note: 用作名词贬称外貌或行为异常的人时带侮辱性。

senses.en: Making illegal copies of documents or artworks; such a copy.

ex.en: The painting in the shop was a forgery.
ex.zh: 商店里的那幅画是一件赝品。

ex.en: Museums employ specialists to detect forgery and protect the public from misleading claims about historical objects.
ex.zh: 博物馆聘请专家识别伪造品，避免公众被有关历史文物的不实说法误导。

col: a convincing forgery｜足以乱真的赝品
words.tip: forgery是伪造或赝品；锻造作坊是forge。

senses.en: the upper edge of a cup, bowl, or other container
the part of a hat extending outward around its base
to be full of liquid or a strong feeling

ex.en: She filled my cup to the brim with tea.
ex.zh: 她把我的杯子倒满了茶。

ex.en: Community centres brimming with activity can strengthen social connections and reduce isolation among older residents.
ex.zh: 活动丰富的社区中心能够加强社会联系，减少老年居民的孤独感。

col: to the brim｜到满沿；满满地
words.tip: 满到杯沿用to the brim；充满用brim with。

senses.en: Likely to experience something, especially something unpleasant.
Legally responsible for something, especially damage or payment.

ex.en: These old pipes are liable to burst in winter.
ex.zh: 这些旧水管在冬天很容易爆裂。

ex.en: Employers may be held liable for injuries caused by unsafe conditions in the workplace.
ex.zh: 雇主可能须对工作场所不安全条件造成的伤害承担法律责任。

col: liable to do something｜很可能做某事
liable for damages｜负有损害赔偿责任
be held liable｜被认定负有法律责任
words.tip: liable to后接动词表可能；liable for表责任。

senses.en: To send someone or something to a particular destination.
The act of sending goods, messages, or people somewhere.
An official message or a report sent by a journalist.

ex.en: The shop dispatched my new shoes this morning.
ex.zh: 商店今天早上寄出了我的新鞋。

ex.en: Local authorities should dispatch emergency teams quickly when severe flooding threatens homes and essential infrastructure.
ex.zh: 当严重洪灾威胁住宅和关键基础设施时，地方政府应迅速派出应急队伍。

words.tip: despatch也是正确拼写，但dispatch更常见。

senses.en: The arrangement of objects in a straight line or correct position.
Agreement between ideas, aims, or actions.
An association between groups sharing political aims or interests.

ex.en: The mechanic checked the alignment of my front wheels.
ex.zh: 修理工检查了我的前轮定位。

ex.en: Closer alignment between school curricula and workplace needs could improve employment prospects for young graduates.
ex.zh: 学校课程与职场需求更加协调，有助于改善年轻毕业生的就业前景。

words.tip: in alignment with可指位置对齐或目标一致。

senses.en: Someone who supports government based on the people's choices

senses.zh: 美国民主党党员或支持者
senses.en: A member or supporter of the Democratic Party in America

ex.en: As a democrat, she wants everyone to have a vote.
ex.zh: 作为民主主义者，她希望人人都有投票权。

ex.en: A committed democrat should defend fair elections even when the results favour a competing political party.
ex.zh: 坚定的民主主义者即使面对有利于竞争政党的结果，也应捍卫公正的选举。

col: committed democrat｜坚定的民主主义者
lifelong democrat｜终身信奉民主的人
words.tip: 泛指民主主义者用小写；美国民主党人写作Democrat。

senses.en: a desire to hurt someone or cause them trouble

ex.en: There was no malice in his teasing smile.
ex.zh: 他打趣的笑容里并没有恶意。

ex.en: Schools should distinguish between careless remarks and comments made with malice when addressing conflicts among students.
ex.zh: 学校在处理学生之间的冲突时，应区分无心之言和恶意评论。

words.tip: 通常不可数；with malice 表示“怀着恶意”。

senses.en: Official confirmation that someone or something meets required standards.

ex.en: The swimming instructor proudly showed us her new certification.
ex.zh: 游泳教练自豪地向我们展示了她新取得的资格证明。

ex.en: Independent certification helps consumers identify products that meet recognised environmental standards throughout the production process.
ex.zh: 独立认证帮助消费者识别在整个生产过程中符合公认环保标准的产品。

words.tip: certification重认证；certificate常指证书本身。

senses.en: needed for a particular purpose
something necessary for a particular purpose

ex.en: She has the requisite skills to repair this bicycle.
ex.zh: 她具备修理这辆自行车所必需的技能。

ex.en: Applicants without the requisite qualifications may benefit from training programmes designed to improve access to skilled employment.
ex.zh: 不具备必要资历的申请者或可受益于旨在帮助人们进入技术岗位的培训项目。

col: a requisite for success｜成功的必要条件
words.tip: 较正式；requisite 指必需，prerequisite 强调先决。

senses.en: Dishonest behaviour intended to make someone believe something false.

ex.en: His deceit became clear when we opened the empty box.
ex.zh: 我们打开空盒子时，他的骗局就暴露了。

ex.en: Deceit in advertising can damage consumer trust and create unfair advantages for companies that misrepresent their products.
ex.zh: 广告中的欺骗行为会损害消费者信任，并让虚假宣传产品的企业获得不公平的优势。

col: an act of deceit｜欺骗行为
words.tip: deceit通常不可数；一次欺骗可用an act of deceit。

senses.en: A temporary stop to an activity or someone's participation
Vehicle parts that reduce shaking on uneven roads
A liquid containing undissolved particles, or their state within it

ex.en: The storm caused the suspension of all ferry services.
ex.zh: 暴风雨导致所有渡轮服务暂停。

ex.en: The temporary suspension of construction work allowed researchers to assess the project's impact on local wildlife.
ex.zh: 建筑工程的暂时停工让研究人员得以评估该项目对当地野生动物的影响。

words.tip: 表示暂时中止；车辆语境中指悬架。

senses.en: To spread through or occupy a place in unwanted numbers.
To continue beyond an agreed time or cost limit.
An amount by which planned time or costs are exceeded.

ex.en: Weeds have overrun the garden since our neighbours moved away.
ex.zh: 邻居搬走后，花园里就长满了杂草。

ex.en: Major infrastructure projects often overrun their budgets when planners underestimate material costs and construction delays.
ex.zh: 规划者低估材料成本和施工延误时，大型基础设施项目往往会超支。

col: be overrun with weeds｜杂草丛生
words.tip: 变化为overran、overrun；名词重音在首音节。

senses.en: playing an important part in making something happen
performed with musical instruments rather than voices
a piece of music performed without singing

ex.en: Your advice was instrumental in helping me find work.
ex.zh: 你的建议对我找到工作起了重要作用。

ex.en: Investment in public transport has been instrumental in reducing traffic congestion in several major cities.
ex.zh: 对公共交通的投资在缓解多个大城市的交通拥堵方面起了重要作用。

col: be instrumental in｜在……中起重要作用
words.tip: 表示“起重要作用”时，用 be instrumental in doing。

senses.en: Unfair treatment of people to gain benefits from their work
Using resources or opportunities to gain an advantage

ex.en: The workers demanded fair wages and protection from exploitation.
ex.zh: 工人们要求合理的工资，并要求得到保护免受剥削。

ex.en: The uncontrolled exploitation of natural resources can damage ecosystems and undermine the livelihoods of communities that depend on them.
ex.zh: 对自然资源的无节制开发会破坏生态系统，并损害依赖这些资源的社区居民的生计。

col: exploitation of natural resources｜自然资源的开发利用
words.tip: 用于人常指剥削；用于资源指开发利用，需看语境。

senses.en: A drug used to calm people or animals and reduce anxiety.

ex.en: The vet gave the frightened horse a tranquilizer.
ex.zh: 兽医给受惊的马用了一剂镇静药。

ex.en: Doctors should carefully assess the risks before prescribing a tranquilizer to a patient with persistent anxiety.
ex.zh: 医生在给持续焦虑的患者开镇静药之前，应仔细评估风险。

words.tip: 美式常拼tranquilizer，英式常拼tranquilliser。

senses.en: Most common or influential at a particular time or place.

ex.en: The prevailing mood at dinner was one of relief.
ex.zh: 晚餐时，大家普遍都松了一口气。

ex.en: The prevailing view among urban planners is that reliable public transport can reduce dependence on private cars.
ex.zh: 城市规划者普遍认为，可靠的公共交通能减少人们对私家车的依赖。

words.tip: 常置于名词前；prevailing wind指盛行风。

senses.en: A short period when activity or noise becomes less intense.
To calm someone or gently help them fall asleep.
To make someone feel safe when danger may still exist.

ex.en: We stepped outside during a lull in the rain.
ex.zh: 趁雨暂时停歇，我们走到了外面。

ex.en: A temporary lull in economic activity may give businesses time to review their long-term strategies.
ex.zh: 经济活动的暂时放缓可能让企业有时间重新审视其长期战略。

col: a lull in activity｜活动的暂时停歇
lull someone to sleep｜哄某人入睡
lull someone into a false sense of security｜使某人产生虚假的安全感
words.tip: lull强调暂时平静，不表示彻底结束。

senses.en: extremely unpleasant or offensive

ex.en: An obnoxious passenger played loud music throughout the journey.
ex.zh: 一个讨厌的乘客一路都在大声播放音乐。

ex.en: Obnoxious behaviour on public transport can discourage commuters from using otherwise convenient and affordable services.
ex.zh: 公共交通上的恶劣行为可能让通勤者不愿使用原本便捷又实惠的服务。

words.tip: 语气比annoying强，常形容无礼的人或行为。

senses.en: Hang or bend down, often from weakness or tiredness.

ex.en: The flowers began to droop in the afternoon heat.
ex.zh: 鲜花在午后的高温下开始低垂。

ex.en: During prolonged droughts, leaves often droop as plants lose water and struggle to maintain their structure.
ex.zh: 长期干旱期间，植物因失水而难以维持形态，叶片往往会下垂。

words.tip: 常形容花叶、眼皮或肩膀因缺水、疲倦而下垂。

senses.en: Speed in acting, often without enough care or thought.

ex.en: In my haste, I left my keys on the table.
ex.zh: 我匆忙之中把钥匙落在了桌上。

ex.en: Policies developed in haste may overlook the needs of vulnerable groups and create additional social problems.
ex.zh: 仓促制定的政策可能忽视弱势群体的需求，并引发更多社会问题。

words.tip: 通常为不可数名词；in haste意为匆忙地。

senses.en: to release sweat through your skin, especially when hot

ex.en: I began to perspire while carrying the heavy boxes.
ex.zh: 搬那些沉重的箱子时，我开始出汗了。

ex.en: People perspire more during intense exercise because the body needs to release excess heat.
ex.zh: 剧烈运动时人会出更多汗，因为身体需要散发多余的热量。

words.tip: 比sweat正式；通常作不及物动词。

senses.en: The supply of water to land so crops can grow.

ex.en: The farm's irrigation system keeps these vegetables growing.
ex.zh: 农场的灌溉系统让这些蔬菜持续生长。

ex.en: Efficient irrigation can increase crop yields while reducing water consumption in regions affected by drought.
ex.zh: 在受干旱影响的地区，高效灌溉可以提高作物产量，同时减少用水量。

words.tip: 通常为不可数名词；动词形式是irrigate。

senses.en: To officially choose someone or something for a particular purpose.
To give something an official name or identifying description.

ex.en: We designated one cupboard for all our cleaning supplies.
ex.zh: 我们指定了一个橱柜专门存放所有清洁用品。

ex.en: Local authorities should designate more urban land as protected green space to improve residents' quality of life.
ex.zh: 地方政府应将更多城市土地划为受保护的绿地，以改善居民的生活质量。

col: designate an area for｜划定区域用于
words.tip: designate A as B表示指定或认定A为B。

senses.en: to become smaller or weaker, or make something so
to make someone or something seem less important or valuable

ex.en: The pain in my ankle gradually diminished overnight.
ex.zh: 一夜之间，我脚踝的疼痛逐渐减轻了。

ex.en: Investment in reliable public transport can diminish dependence on private cars and improve air quality in crowded cities.
ex.zh: 投资建设可靠的公共交通可以减少对私家车的依赖，改善拥挤城市的空气质量。

words.tip: 既可及物也可不及物：信心可diminish，也可被削弱。

senses.en: The middle of a place, group, activity, or situation.

ex.en: We found a quiet garden in the midst of town.
ex.zh: 我们在镇中心找到了一座安静的花园。

ex.en: In the midst of rapid urban growth, planners must preserve accessible green spaces for residents.
ex.zh: 在城市快速发展的过程中，规划者必须为居民保留便于到达的绿地。

words.tip: 通常用于in the midst of，表示身处其中或正值某时。

senses.en: The universe considered as a complete, ordered system.

ex.en: Looking through the telescope made me curious about the cosmos.
ex.zh: 透过望远镜观察让我对宇宙产生了好奇。

ex.en: Studying the cosmos helps scientists investigate how galaxies formed and how the universe has changed over time.
ex.zh: 研究宇宙有助于科学家探究星系如何形成，以及宇宙如何随时间演变。

col: the origins of the cosmos｜宇宙的起源
the vastness of the cosmos｜宇宙的浩瀚
words.tip: 表示宇宙时通常用the cosmos。

senses.en: stay hidden, often waiting to do something
exist unnoticed and potentially cause trouble

ex.en: A cat lurked behind the sofa, watching my shoelaces.
ex.zh: 一只猫躲在沙发后面，盯着我的鞋带。

ex.en: Security risks may lurk in outdated software, making regular system updates essential for protecting personal information.
ex.zh: 过时的软件中可能暗藏安全风险，因此定期更新系统对保护个人信息至关重要。

col: lurk in the shadows｜潜伏在暗处
words.tip: 通常作不及物动词；可用危险等抽象事物作主语。

senses.en: Make sure that people obey a law or rule.

ex.en: The pool staff enforce strict rules about running indoors.
ex.zh: 泳池工作人员严格执行禁止在室内奔跑的规定。

ex.en: Governments must enforce environmental regulations consistently if they want industries to reduce pollution and protect public health.
ex.zh: 政府若希望各行业减少污染、保护公众健康，就必须始终如一地执行环境法规。

words.tip: enforce后接法律或规定；迫使某人做事用force。

senses.en: Suggested or understood without being directly stated.
Present as a necessary part of something.
Complete and without doubt, especially describing trust or confidence.

ex.en: Her welcoming smile was an implicit invitation to join.
ex.zh: 她热情的笑容是在默默邀请我们加入。

ex.en: Many workplaces have implicit expectations about overtime, which can make employees reluctant to leave on time.
ex.zh: 许多工作场所对加班有不成文的期待，这可能让员工不敢准时下班。

col: implicit agreement｜默契；未明说的协议
words.tip: implicit指未明说；explicit指清楚明确。

senses.en: Someone who helps opposing sides reach an agreement

ex.en: A mediator helped our neighbours settle their garden fence dispute.
ex.zh: 一位调解人帮助我们的邻居解决了花园围栏纠纷。

ex.en: An independent mediator can help employers and workers negotiate fair conditions without resorting to lengthy legal proceedings.
ex.zh: 独立调解人可以帮助雇主和员工协商公平的工作条件，而不必诉诸漫长的法律程序。

col: act as a mediator｜担任调解人
words.tip: 调解人促成双方协议，通常不直接作出裁决。

senses.en: Someone arranging deals or buying goods to sell to others.

ex.en: We bought directly from the farmer, avoiding the middleman.
ex.zh: 我们直接向农民购买，绕过了中间商。

ex.en: Online platforms allow small producers to reach consumers directly, reducing their dependence on a traditional middleman.
ex.zh: 网络平台让小生产者能够直接接触消费者，减少对传统中间商的依赖。

col: cut out the middleman｜绕过中间商
act as a middleman｜充当中介人
words.tip: 复数为 middlemen；中性表达可用 intermediary。

senses.en: An official penalty intended to enforce rules or change behaviour.
To officially approve or permit an action.
To impose an official penalty on someone or something.

ex.en: The club imposed a sanction for breaking its rules.
ex.zh: 俱乐部对违反规定的行为作出了处罚。

ex.en: Economic sanctions may influence government policy, but they can also create hardship for ordinary citizens.
ex.zh: 经济制裁可能影响政府政策，但也可能给普通民众带来困苦。

words.tip: 可指“制裁”或“批准”，含义相反，须看语境。

senses.en: A short pointed knife, usually with two sharp edges.

ex.en: An ancient dagger lay inside the museum's glass case.
ex.zh: 一把古代匕首陈列在博物馆的玻璃展柜里。

ex.en: The discovery of a decorated dagger provides evidence of advanced metalworking skills in this ancient settlement.
ex.zh: 一把带装饰的匕首的发现，证明了这个古代聚居地具备先进的金属加工技艺。

col: look daggers at someone｜怒视某人
words.tip: look daggers at someone是习语，意为怒视某人。

senses.en: Relating to electricity produced by the movement of water.

ex.en: We visited a hydroelectric dam during our mountain holiday.
ex.zh: 我们在山区度假时参观了一座水电大坝。

ex.en: Hydroelectric power can reduce dependence on fossil fuels, although large dams may disrupt river ecosystems.
ex.zh: 水力发电可以减少对化石燃料的依赖，但大型水坝可能扰乱河流生态系统。

words.tip: 常修饰power或power station；名词为hydroelectricity。

senses.en: continued effort despite difficulties or delays
the fact of continuing to exist over time

ex.en: After weeks of practice, his persistence finally paid off.
ex.zh: 经过几周练习，他的坚持终于有了回报。

ex.en: The persistence of poverty suggests that economic growth alone cannot guarantee better living conditions for every household.
ex.zh: 贫困的持续存在表明，仅靠经济增长无法保证每个家庭的生活条件都得到改善。

col: persistence pays off｜坚持终有回报
the persistence of poverty｜贫困的持续存在
words.tip: 既可指人的毅力，也可指问题或现象持续存在。

senses.en: Usually, or when conditions are normal.

ex.en: We ordinarily eat outside, but today it is raining.
ex.zh: 我们通常在户外吃饭，但今天下雨了。

ex.en: Public libraries ordinarily provide free internet access, helping residents who cannot afford a connection at home.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆通常提供免费网络，帮助那些无力负担家庭网络费用的居民。

words.tip: 表示“通常”，不表示推测性的“大概”。

senses.en: Happening immediately, with no noticeable delay.

ex.en: The relief was almost instantaneous when I removed my shoes.
ex.zh: 我一脱下鞋，几乎立刻就感觉轻松了。

ex.en: Modern communication networks allow almost instantaneous exchanges of information between researchers working on different continents.
ex.zh: 现代通信网络让不同大洲的研究人员几乎能够即时交换信息。

words.tip: 强调几乎没有时间间隔，不等于同时发生。

senses.en: an event when one celestial body blocks another's light
make something seem less important or impressive by comparison

ex.en: We watched the lunar eclipse from our garden last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我们在花园里观看了月食。

ex.en: Investment in digital services may eclipse spending on traditional infrastructure as economies become increasingly dependent on technology.
ex.zh: 随着经济日益依赖科技，数字服务投资可能超过传统基础设施支出。

col: eclipse previous achievements｜使以往成就黯然失色
words.tip: 日食用solar eclipse，月食用lunar eclipse。

senses.en: Get back something that belongs or previously belonged to you
Make damaged or submerged land suitable for use
Recover useful materials from waste for reuse

ex.en: I returned to the station to reclaim my suitcase.
ex.zh: 我回到车站取回自己的行李箱。

ex.en: Coastal cities sometimes reclaim land from the sea to create space for housing and transport.
ex.zh: 沿海城市有时通过填海造地，为住房和交通设施腾出空间。

col: reclaim land｜开垦土地；填海造地
words.tip: reclaim强调收回或恢复利用，不只是收集。

senses.en: directly related to the matter being discussed

ex.en: Lena asked a pertinent question about the repair costs.
ex.zh: 莉娜问了一个关于维修费用的切题问题。

ex.en: Evidence about local air quality is particularly pertinent to discussions of expanding public transport networks.
ex.zh: 有关当地空气质量的证据与扩大公共交通网络的讨论尤其相关。

words.tip: 常用pertinent to表示与某事相关，语体较正式。

senses.en: the projecting nose and mouth of an animal

ex.en: The pig pushed its snout through the wooden fence.
ex.zh: 那头猪把口鼻部伸过了木栅栏。

ex.en: A pig's sensitive snout helps it locate food beneath the soil, supporting its natural foraging behaviour.
ex.zh: 猪灵敏的口鼻部帮助它找到土壤下的食物，满足其自然觅食的需要。

words.tip: 不只指猪嘴，也指其他动物突出的口鼻部。

senses.en: Too willing to believe what others say, even when untrue

ex.en: I was gullible enough to believe his ridiculous story.
ex.zh: 我太轻信了，竟然相信了他那荒唐的故事。

ex.en: Teaching media literacy can help gullible consumers recognise misleading advertisements and make better informed purchasing decisions.
ex.zh: 教授媒介素养可以帮助容易受骗的消费者识别误导性广告，作出更明智的购买决定。

col: gullible consumers｜容易受骗的消费者
gullible enough to believe｜轻信到竟然相信
words.tip: 带贬义，强调容易相信假话，不等于善良。

senses.en: A small, very sharp knife used in surgery or dissection.

ex.en: The surgeon placed the scalpel on a clean tray.
ex.zh: 外科医生把手术刀放在干净的托盘上。

ex.en: Medical students practise using a scalpel on artificial tissue before developing more advanced surgical skills.
ex.zh: 医学生先在人工组织上练习使用手术刀，再学习更高级的外科技能。

words.tip: 可数名词，指精细切割用的手术刀或解剖刀。

senses.en: a religious talk given during a service
a long talk telling someone how they should behave

ex.en: The sermon encouraged everyone to help their neighbours.
ex.zh: 这场布道鼓励大家帮助邻居。

ex.en: A sermon can strengthen community ties by encouraging listeners to support vulnerable people and participate in local projects.
ex.zh: 布道可以鼓励听众帮助弱势群体、参与本地项目，从而加强社区联系。

col: a sermon on kindness｜关于善意的布道
words.tip: 本义为宗教讲道；比喻“说教”时常带不满。

senses.en: By which a particular result is achieved.

ex.en: We have an arrangement whereby we share the cooking.
ex.zh: 我们有个安排，轮流负责做饭。

ex.en: Schools could introduce a system whereby older students provide academic support to younger pupils after lessons.
ex.zh: 学校可以引入一种制度，让高年级学生在课后为低年级学生提供学业帮助。

col: a system whereby｜借以实现某事的制度
a process whereby｜借以实现某事的过程
an arrangement whereby｜据此实行的安排
words.tip: 正式关系副词，常接在system等词后，相当于by which。

senses.en: to limit or control something unwanted
a limit on an activity or behaviour
the raised edge between a road and pavement

ex.en: I try to curb my spending by cooking at home.
ex.zh: 我尽量在家做饭，以控制开支。

ex.en: Cities can curb air pollution by improving public transport and encouraging residents to cycle.
ex.zh: 城市可以通过改善公共交通和鼓励居民骑车来抑制空气污染。

col: a curb on emissions｜对排放的限制
words.tip: 作动词指抑制；路缘石在英式英语中拼作kerb。

senses.en: The state of having no end or limit.
A mathematical concept greater than any finite quantity.

ex.en: The desert seemed to stretch away into infinity.
ex.zh: 沙漠仿佛一直延伸到无穷远处。

ex.en: The concept of infinity allows mathematicians to explore quantities beyond the limits of ordinary measurement.
ex.zh: 无穷的概念使数学家能够研究超出常规测量范围的量。

col: stretch into infinity｜延伸至无穷远
an infinity of possibilities｜无穷的可能性
words.tip: 不是一般的“大量”；数学中常用趋于无穷大。

senses.en: to reach a conclusion using evidence rather than direct statements

ex.en: From her muddy shoes, I inferred she had been gardening.
ex.zh: 从她沾满泥土的鞋子，我推断她刚才在做园艺活。

ex.en: Researchers cannot infer that smaller classes improve learning without examining other factors affecting student performance.
ex.zh: 研究人员如果不考察影响学生表现的其他因素，就不能推断小班教学能改善学习效果。

col: infer from evidence｜根据证据推断
words.tip: infer是听者推断，imply是说者暗示。

senses.zh: 兴高采烈的；欣喜若狂的
senses.en: Extremely happy and excited, especially after success or good news.

ex.en: Lina was elated when she finally passed her driving test.
ex.zh: 莉娜终于通过驾照考试时，欣喜万分。

ex.en: Graduates may feel elated after securing their first job, although adjusting to workplace expectations can be challenging.
ex.zh: 毕业生找到第一份工作后可能欣喜万分，尽管适应职场要求并不容易。

col: elated at the news｜听到消息欣喜万分
elated by success｜因成功而欢欣鼓舞
words.tip: 比happy语气更强，常用于成功或获悉好消息后。

senses.en: The ability to pay all the debts you owe.

ex.en: The accountant checked the firm's solvency before approving the purchase.
ex.zh: 会计在批准这笔采购前检查了公司的偿付能力。

ex.en: Stricter financial regulation can protect bank solvency and reduce the risk of a wider economic crisis.
ex.zh: 更严格的金融监管能够保障银行的偿付能力，降低更大范围经济危机的风险。

words.tip: solvency指偿债能力，不等于盈利能力。

senses.en: relating to high mountains, especially the Alps

ex.en: Tiny alpine flowers grew between rocks beside the trail.
ex.zh: 小小的高山花朵生长在小径旁的岩石缝中。

ex.en: Rising temperatures threaten alpine ecosystems by reducing snow cover and forcing mountain species to move higher.
ex.zh: 气温上升使积雪覆盖减少，并迫使山地物种向更高处迁移，从而威胁高山生态系统。

words.tip: 泛指高山环境用小写；专指阿尔卑斯山常大写。

senses.en: A batch of goods sent to a person or place.
An arrangement where sellers pay suppliers only after goods sell.

ex.en: A consignment of fresh oranges arrived at the shop.
ex.zh: 一批新鲜橙子运到了店里。

ex.en: Delays in inspecting a consignment of medical equipment can disrupt essential services in remote communities.
ex.zh: 一批医疗设备的检验延误，可能会影响偏远社区的基本服务。

col: a consignment of goods｜一批货物
receive a consignment｜收到一批货物
words.tip: on consignment指寄售，卖出后再向供货方付款。

senses.en: a mammal belonging to the group including humans, monkeys, and apes

ex.en: The guide pointed to a primate swinging between branches.
ex.zh: 导游指着一只在树枝间荡来荡去的灵长类动物。

ex.en: Protecting tropical forests is essential for the survival of many primate species threatened by habitat loss.
ex.zh: 保护热带森林对许多因栖息地丧失而受到威胁的灵长类物种的生存至关重要。

col: primate behaviour｜灵长类动物的行为
words.tip: 包括人、猿和猴；并非只指猴子。

senses.en: Reminding you of something because of a similarity.

ex.en: The soup's flavour was reminiscent of my grandmother's cooking.
ex.zh: 这汤的味道让我想起了祖母做的饭菜。

ex.en: The proposed station design is reminiscent of traditional architecture, helping the building blend into its historic surroundings.
ex.zh: 拟建车站的设计令人联想到传统建筑，有助于其融入周围的历史环境。

col: reminiscent of childhood｜令人想起童年的
strongly reminiscent of｜令人强烈联想到
vaguely reminiscent of｜隐约使人想起
words.tip: 固定搭配be reminiscent of，介词不用about。

senses.en: Very great in effect, degree, or intensity.
Showing deep thought, understanding, or insight.

ex.en: Meeting my childhood teacher filled me with profound gratitude.
ex.zh: 见到儿时的老师让我心中充满了深深的感激。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet has had a profound impact on educational opportunities in remote communities.
ex.zh: 可靠的互联网接入对偏远社区的教育机会产生了深远影响。

words.tip: 常修饰impact、change、understanding，不指物理深度。

senses.en: Behaving illegally or antisocially, especially while young.
Not paid on time, or failing to pay on time.
A person, usually young, who breaks the law.

ex.en: The youth centre helps teenagers change their delinquent behaviour.
ex.zh: 这家青少年中心帮助青少年改正违法行为。

ex.en: Early support for vulnerable families may reduce delinquent behaviour more effectively than harsher punishments alone.
ex.zh: 及早扶助弱势家庭，可能比单纯加重惩罚更有效地减少违法行为。

col: a delinquent borrower｜拖欠还款的借款人
words.tip: 金融语境中指逾期未付；日常多指青少年违法。

senses.en: Walk with long, confident steps.
A long step taken while walking or running.
Important progress towards a goal, usually expressed in the plural.

ex.en: Leila strode across the platform to catch her train.
ex.zh: 莱拉大步穿过站台去赶火车。

ex.en: Many countries have made significant strides in improving access to primary education over recent decades.
ex.zh: 近几十年来，许多国家在扩大初等教育机会方面取得了显著进展。

col: stride across a room｜大步穿过房间
make great strides｜取得巨大进展
take something in your stride｜从容应对某事
words.tip: 过去式strode，过去分词stridden；进展常用strides。

senses.en: the right to provide or use something without competitors

senses.zh: 排他性；仅限少数人享有
senses.en: the quality of being available only to a select group

ex.en: The bakery secured exclusivity to sell bread at the festival.
ex.zh: 这家面包店取得了在该节庆活动中独家销售面包的权利。

ex.en: Although exclusivity agreements can encourage investment, they may also limit competition and raise prices for consumers.
ex.zh: 虽然独家协议能够鼓励投资，但也可能限制竞争并推高消费者支付的价格。

words.tip: 既可指商业独家权，也可指仅少数人享有的特性。

senses.en: the scientific study of animals

ex.en: My cousin studies zoology and spends weekends watching birds.
ex.zh: 我的表亲学习动物学，周末常去观察鸟类。

ex.en: Research in zoology helps scientists understand animal behaviour and design more effective strategies for protecting endangered species.
ex.zh: 动物学研究帮助科学家理解动物行为，并制定更有效的濒危物种保护策略。

col: a degree in zoology｜动物学学位
words.tip: 通常为不可数名词；研究植物的学科是botany。

senses.en: A form that differs slightly from other related forms.
Differing in some way from the usual or related form.

ex.en: This local variant of the soup includes fresh beans.
ex.zh: 这种汤的本地做法加入了新鲜豆子。

ex.en: A genetic variant may affect how individuals respond to certain medicines, making personalised treatment increasingly important.
ex.zh: 某种基因变异可能影响个体对特定药物的反应，因此个性化治疗日益重要。

words.tip: 名词常用a variant of；形容词可修饰spelling等。

senses.en: a group living together and sharing possessions and responsibilities

ex.en: They live in a commune and grow vegetables together.
ex.zh: 他们住在一个共同生活的群体中，一起种菜。

ex.en: Living in a commune can reduce individual expenses, but shared decision-making requires patience and effective communication.
ex.zh: 公社生活可以减少个人开支，但共同决策需要耐心和有效沟通。

col: live in a commune｜在公社生活
words.tip: 名词指共同生活群体；动词 commune with 指心灵交流。

senses.en: To feel or express strong anger.
Strong, unpleasant or harmful gas or smoke, usually plural.

ex.en: He fumed when muddy shoes stained his clean carpet.
ex.zh: 泥鞋弄脏了他干净的地毯，他气坏了。

ex.en: Exposure to exhaust fumes can worsen respiratory conditions, particularly among children living near busy roads.
ex.zh: 接触汽车尾气可能加重呼吸系统疾病，尤其会影响住在繁忙道路附近的儿童。

col: fume over something｜为某事大发脾气
words.tip: 表示烟气通常用复数fumes；动词常指十分恼怒。

senses.en: from this time onwards

ex.en: Henceforth, we will keep spare keys in this drawer.
ex.zh: 从今以后，我们会把备用钥匙放在这个抽屉里。

ex.en: The university announced that all new buildings would henceforth meet stricter environmental standards.
ex.zh: 大学宣布，今后所有新建建筑都将达到更严格的环保标准。

col: be henceforth known as｜从此被称为
words.tip: 正式用语；日常交流多用 from now on。

senses.en: Carrying or holding a large amount of something.
Full of a particular feeling, especially an unpleasant one.

ex.en: She arrived at the picnic laden with bags of food.
ex.zh: 她带着大包小包的食物来到野餐地点。

ex.en: Trucks laden with construction materials contribute to congestion and increase road maintenance costs in rapidly expanding cities.
ex.zh: 在迅速扩张的城市中，满载建筑材料的卡车加剧了拥堵，并增加了道路维护成本。

words.tip: 常用laden with；也可构成sugar-laden等复合形容词。

senses.en: greatest in degree, amount, or intensity
the greatest effort or amount someone can achieve

ex.en: Please handle this delicate glass bowl with utmost care.
ex.zh: 请极其小心地拿放这只易碎的玻璃碗。

ex.en: Protecting patient privacy is of the utmost importance when hospitals introduce digital systems for storing medical records.
ex.zh: 医院引入电子病历存储系统时，保护患者隐私至关重要。

col: of the utmost importance｜极为重要
words.tip: do one's utmost意为尽最大努力，常接to do。

senses.en: providing extra help or support when needed
a verb used with another verb to form grammatical structures

ex.en: The boat has an auxiliary engine for emergencies.
ex.zh: 这艘船装有一台应急用的备用发动机。

ex.en: Hospitals require auxiliary power systems to maintain essential medical services during unexpected electricity failures.
ex.zh: 医院需要备用供电系统，以便在意外停电时维持必要的医疗服务。

words.tip: 语法中 auxiliary verb 指助动词，如 be、have、do。

senses.en: Find your position or become familiar with your surroundings.
Position something towards a direction or focus it on something.

ex.en: I used the river to orientate myself in town.
ex.zh: 我借助河流来确定自己在城里的方位。

ex.en: Universities should orientate their support services towards the needs of students adjusting to life away from home.
ex.zh: 大学应以适应离家生活的学生的需求为导向，提供支持服务。

col: orientate something towards｜使某事物面向
words.tip: 多用于英式英语；常用orientate oneself，不专指向东。

senses.en: Skill in making things, especially carefully by hand.

ex.en: The handmade chair shows beautiful craftsmanship in every joint.
ex.zh: 这把手工椅子的每一处接合都展现出精湛工艺。

ex.en: Preserving traditional craftsmanship can support local economies while protecting cultural knowledge passed down through generations.
ex.zh: 保护传统手艺既能支持地方经济，也能保护代代相传的文化知识。

words.tip: 不可数名词，强调制作技艺或成品的工艺水平。

senses.en: A tool with a sharp edge for cutting wood or stone.
To cut or shape wood or stone with a chisel.

ex.en: She used a chisel to shape the wooden bowl.
ex.zh: 她用凿子给木碗塑形。

ex.en: Traditional craftspeople use a chisel to create detailed patterns that preserve local artistic traditions.
ex.zh: 传统手艺人用凿子雕出精细图案，传承当地的艺术传统。

col: a hammer and chisel｜锤子和凿子
words.tip: 动词过去式英式常写chiselled，美式常写chiseled。

senses.en: loose rather than tightly stretched
less busy, active, or careful than expected
looseness in a rope, or unused capacity

ex.en: The tent rope was slack after the heavy rain.
ex.zh: 大雨过后，帐篷的绳子松了。

ex.en: When demand is slack, manufacturers may reduce working hours rather than dismiss experienced employees immediately.
ex.zh: 需求疲软时，制造商可能会缩短工作时间，而不是立即解雇有经验的员工。

col: take up the slack｜收紧松弛部分；补位
words.tip: slack指松弛或懈怠；slacks是宽松长裤。

senses.en: Someone who lives in or uses a room, building, or vehicle.

ex.en: The previous occupant left some curtains in the flat.
ex.zh: 上一位住户在公寓里留下了一些窗帘。

ex.en: Building regulations should ensure that every occupant can leave safely in the event of a fire.
ex.zh: 建筑法规应确保每位使用者都能在发生火灾时安全撤离。

words.tip: 强调实际居住或使用，不一定是owner（所有者）。

senses.en: Someone related to a person who lived in an earlier generation.
Something developed from an earlier form of something similar.

ex.en: Her descendants still live in the old family farmhouse.
ex.zh: 她的后代仍住在家族的老农舍里。

ex.en: Preserving traditional crafts allows descendants of local communities to maintain meaningful connections with their cultural heritage.
ex.zh: 保护传统工艺能让当地社区的后代与自身文化遗产保持有意义的联系。

words.tip: descendant是后代；ancestor是祖先。

senses.en: To argue that something is true.
To struggle with a difficulty or challenging situation.
To compete for something against other people.

ex.en: I contend that our kitchen needs a bigger table.
ex.zh: 我认为我们的厨房需要一张更大的桌子。

ex.en: Some researchers contend that affordable public transport is more effective than road expansion in reducing urban congestion.
ex.zh: 一些研究者认为，在缓解城市拥堵方面，价格合理的公共交通比扩建道路更有效。

col: contend for the title｜争夺冠军
words.tip: contend that表主张；with接困难；for接争夺目标。

senses.en: A person or organisation responsible for protecting or managing something.
Someone employed to clean and maintain a building, especially in America.

ex.en: The custodian carefully locked the cabinet containing ancient coins.
ex.zh: 保管人小心地锁好了存放古钱币的柜子。

ex.en: Museums act as custodians of cultural heritage, preserving valuable objects for research and future generations.
ex.zh: 博物馆充当文化遗产的守护者，为研究和后代保存珍贵物品。

col: custodian of cultural heritage｜文化遗产守护者
words.tip: custodian of后接所保管或守护的对象。

senses.en: Small or delicate enough to be difficult to notice
Expressed or achieved indirectly and skilfully

ex.en: The soup has a subtle hint of lemon.
ex.zh: 这汤带有一丝淡淡的柠檬味。

ex.en: Advertising can exert a subtle influence on consumers by associating products with desirable lifestyles.
ex.zh: 广告将产品与令人向往的生活方式联系起来，从而潜移默化地影响消费者。

words.tip: b不发音；常形容难以察觉的差别或影响。

senses.en: To decrease very quickly and sharply.
To fall suddenly and quickly from a high position.

ex.en: Temperatures plummeted overnight, leaving ice on the garden pond.
ex.zh: 气温一夜间骤降，花园池塘结了冰。

ex.en: Demand for private cars could plummet if cities offered reliable, affordable public transport throughout the day.
ex.zh: 如果城市全天提供可靠且价格合理的公共交通，私家车需求可能会大幅下降。

col: plummet to a record low｜跌至历史最低点
words.tip: 常作不及物动词；to接终值，by接降幅。

senses.en: a fixed, oversimplified belief about a group of people
to judge people using fixed beliefs about their group

ex.en: My grandmother challenges the stereotype that older people dislike technology.
ex.zh: 我的祖母打破了老年人不喜欢科技的刻板印象。

ex.en: Schools should challenge gender stereotypes so that all students feel free to pursue their interests.
ex.zh: 学校应挑战性别刻板印象，让所有学生都能自由追求自己的兴趣。

col: challenge a stereotype｜挑战刻板印象
words.tip: 常指对某类人的简单化看法，不等同于事实。

senses.en: continuing for a long time or happening repeatedly
continuing to try despite difficulty or opposition

ex.en: A persistent cough kept me awake throughout the night.
ex.zh: 持续的咳嗽让我整夜都睡不着。

ex.en: Persistent shortages of affordable housing can force young adults to delay leaving their family homes.
ex.zh: 经济适用住房持续短缺，可能迫使年轻人推迟搬离父母家的计划。

col: a persistent problem｜长期存在的问题
words.tip: 修饰问题常含负面意味；修饰人可表示坚持不懈。

senses.en: A long, narrow cut or hollow in a surface.
A strong, steady rhythm that makes music feel engaging.
To cut long, narrow hollows into a surface.

ex.en: Dust had collected in every groove of the wooden door.
ex.zh: 木门的每一道凹槽里都积了灰。

ex.en: The grooves in vehicle tyres channel water away, improving grip and reducing accident risks on wet roads.
ex.zh: 汽车轮胎上的沟槽能够排水，增强抓地力，降低湿滑路面上的事故风险。

col: get into a groove｜进入顺畅状态
words.tip: 具体指表面的长凹槽；音乐中可指鲜明的律动。

senses.en: A long, flat, thick piece of wood.
An important principle or proposal in a political programme.
An exercise holding the body straight above the floor.

ex.en: We laid a plank across the muddy ditch.
ex.zh: 我们在泥泞的沟上架了一块厚木板。

ex.en: Investment in affordable housing should be a central plank of any strategy to reduce urban inequality.
ex.zh: 投资可负担住房应成为任何缩小城市不平等的战略的核心内容。

col: a central plank of policy｜政策的核心内容
hold a plank｜保持平板支撑
words.tip: a central plank of可比喻政策的核心内容。

senses.en: A politically organised community, especially one governed for public benefit.
An association of independent countries, mostly formerly under British rule.

ex.en: The islanders established a commonwealth with an elected council.
ex.zh: 岛民建立了一个由民选议会治理的政治共同体。

ex.en: Members of the Commonwealth cooperate on education and development while maintaining their own independent governments.
ex.zh: 英联邦成员在教育和发展领域开展合作，同时保有各自独立的政府。

words.tip: 指英联邦时首字母大写，通常与the连用。

senses.en: to build something or put it in an upright position
standing straight up rather than bending or lying down

ex.en: We erected our tent beside the lake before sunset.
ex.zh: 日落前，我们在湖边搭好了帐篷。

ex.en: Local authorities plan to erect temporary shelters for families whose homes were damaged by severe flooding.
ex.zh: 地方政府计划搭建临时住所，安置房屋因严重洪灾受损的家庭。

words.tip: 动词比 build 正式；形容词常见于 stand erect。

senses.en: To enjoy something greatly or eagerly anticipate doing it.
Great enjoyment or enthusiasm when doing something.
A sauce of chopped vegetables or fruit eaten with food.

ex.en: I relish quiet mornings with tea and a book.
ex.zh: 我很享受喝着茶、读着书的宁静早晨。

ex.en: Many students relish the opportunity to study abroad because it exposes them to different cultures and perspectives.
ex.zh: 许多学生非常珍惜出国学习的机会，因为这能让他们接触不同的文化和观点。

col: relish a challenge｜乐于接受挑战
relish the opportunity｜欣然把握机会
words.tip: 动词后接名词或动名词，不接to do。

senses.en: To slow down or prevent a process or activity.
To make someone feel unable to act or speak freely.

ex.en: Cold weather can inhibit the growth of these plants.
ex.zh: 寒冷天气会抑制这些植物的生长。

ex.en: Fear of making mistakes can inhibit students from participating actively in classroom discussions and collaborative tasks.
ex.zh: 害怕犯错可能使学生不敢积极参与课堂讨论和合作任务。

words.tip: inhibit侧重抑制或阻碍；prohibit指明令禁止。

senses.en: A chess piece of the smallest size and lowest value.

senses.zh: 被人利用的小人物；棋子
senses.en: A person controlled by others for their own purposes.
To leave something valuable with a pawnbroker for a loan.

ex.en: She moved a pawn forward and studied the chessboard.
ex.zh: 她把一个兵向前走了一步，然后仔细观察棋盘。

ex.en: Workers should not become pawns in disputes between powerful companies competing for control of essential services.
ex.zh: 在争夺基本服务控制权的大公司之间的纠纷中，劳动者不应成为被利用的棋子。

col: a pawn in a power struggle｜权力斗争中的棋子
words.tip: 典当是以物换借款，可赎回，不等于直接出售。

senses.zh: 帝国主义；帝国扩张政策
senses.en: A policy of extending a country's power over other countries.

ex.en: We discussed imperialism after visiting the history museum yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天参观历史博物馆后，我们讨论了帝国主义。

ex.en: The legacy of imperialism continues to influence economic relationships and debates about cultural identity in many societies.
ex.zh: 帝国主义的遗留影响仍在塑造许多社会的经济关系及有关文化认同的讨论。

col: the legacy of imperialism｜帝国主义的遗留影响
words.tip: 通常不可数；强调一国向外扩张统治或影响力。

senses.en: a writer of short pieces exploring particular subjects

ex.en: The essayist described her childhood with warmth and humour.
ex.zh: 这位散文作家温暖而幽默地描写了自己的童年。

ex.en: An influential essayist can encourage readers to question social assumptions through personal reflection and careful argument.
ex.zh: 有影响力的随笔作家可以通过个人反思和严谨论证，促使读者质疑社会中的惯常观念。

col: a literary essayist｜文学散文作家
a celebrated essayist｜著名随笔作家
a novelist and essayist｜小说家兼散文作家
words.tip: 指以散文或随笔创作为业者，不泛指写作文的学生。

senses.en: To make something seem small by comparison.

senses.zh: 矮小动植物；传说中矮人
senses.en: An unusually small organism, or a small humanlike fantasy creature.
Much smaller than the usual size of its kind.

ex.en: The new tower dwarfs every house on our street.
ex.zh: 新建的高塔让我们街上所有房屋都显得很矮小。

ex.en: The long-term costs of environmental damage may dwarf the immediate profits generated by industrial expansion.
ex.zh: 环境破坏的长期成本可能远远超过工业扩张带来的眼前利润。

col: be dwarfed by｜与……相比显得渺小
words.tip: 动词常表对比悬殊；名词指人可能冒犯，应谨慎。

senses.en: an official responsible for a public service or commission

ex.en: The commissioner visited our neighbourhood to discuss road safety.
ex.zh: 这位专员来到我们社区讨论道路安全问题。

ex.en: An independent commissioner should investigate public complaints and ensure that government agencies treat citizens fairly.
ex.zh: 独立专员应调查公众投诉，并确保政府机构公平对待公民。

words.tip: 通常指负有特定公共职责的官员，不泛指所有委员。

senses.en: Destruction or killing on a very large scale.

senses.zh: 纳粹对犹太人的大屠杀
senses.en: The Nazi murder of six million Jews during World War Two.

ex.en: The film follows a family escaping a nuclear holocaust.
ex.zh: 这部电影讲述一个家庭逃离核毁灭的经历。

ex.en: Teaching students about the Holocaust can encourage critical reflection on prejudice, discrimination, and human rights.
ex.zh: 向学生讲授纳粹大屠杀的历史，可以促进他们对偏见、歧视和人权的批判性思考。

col: Holocaust survivors｜纳粹大屠杀幸存者
words.tip: 特指纳粹大屠杀时用the Holocaust，首字母大写。

senses.en: A ceremony formally marking someone's start in an important public office.
The formal opening or beginning of a facility or activity.

ex.en: We gathered outside to watch the new president's inauguration.
ex.zh: 我们聚在外面观看新总统的就职典礼。

ex.en: The inauguration of the new railway marked a major step towards improving transport links between rural communities.
ex.zh: 新铁路的启用标志着改善农村社区间交通联系迈出了重要一步。

col: a presidential inauguration｜总统就职典礼
an inauguration ceremony｜就职或启用典礼
the inauguration of a new museum｜新博物馆的开馆典礼
words.tip: 既可指领导人就职，也可指设施正式启用。

senses.zh: 柑橘类果树；柑橘类水果
senses.en: Trees producing fruits such as oranges and lemons, or their fruits.
Relating to fruits such as oranges, lemons, and grapefruit.

ex.en: We squeezed fresh citrus juice over the salad.
ex.zh: 我们在沙拉上挤了一些新鲜的柑橘类果汁。

ex.en: Rising temperatures may affect citrus production by increasing water demand and exposing orchards to new pests.
ex.zh: 气温上升可能增加需水量，并使果园面临新的虫害，从而影响柑橘生产。

words.tip: citrus是总称，包括橙、柠檬、葡萄柚等。

senses.en: enthusiastic applause from an audience to show strong approval

ex.en: The young pianist received an ovation after her performance.
ex.zh: 这位年轻钢琴家演奏后赢得了热烈掌声。

ex.en: The orchestra received a standing ovation, demonstrating how live performances can create a powerful sense of community.
ex.zh: 管弦乐团赢得了全场起立鼓掌，展现出现场演出如何营造强烈的群体归属感。

col: receive an ovation｜获得热烈掌声
words.tip: 可数名词；standing ovation指观众起立鼓掌。

senses.en: The state of being easily harmed, affected, or attacked.
A weakness that allows damage or an attack.

ex.en: The storm exposed the vulnerability of our old roof.
ex.zh: 暴风雨暴露了我们旧屋顶的脆弱。

ex.en: Investing in flood defences can reduce the vulnerability of coastal communities to increasingly severe storms.
ex.zh: 投资防洪设施可以降低沿海社区面对日益猛烈的风暴时的脆弱性。

col: vulnerability to flooding｜易受洪水侵袭
words.tip: 泛指脆弱性时不可数；指具体漏洞时可数。

senses.zh: 有教育意义的；有启发的
senses.en: providing useful knowledge or helping someone understand something

ex.en: Watching my grandfather repair the clock was surprisingly instructive.
ex.zh: 看爷爷修钟让我意外地学到了不少东西。

ex.en: Comparing different countries' recycling systems can be instructive for policymakers seeking to reduce household waste.
ex.zh: 比较不同国家的回收体系，能为寻求减少生活垃圾的政策制定者提供启发。

col: an instructive example｜有启发性的例子
an instructive experience｜有教育意义的经历
find something instructive｜觉得某事很有启发
words.tip: 强调让人学到东西，不等于“发出指令的”。

senses.en: A house, flat, or other place where someone lives

ex.en: Their small dwelling overlooks a quiet stretch of river.
ex.zh: 他们的小住宅俯瞰着一段宁静的河流。

ex.en: Every new dwelling should meet energy efficiency standards to reduce household costs and environmental damage.
ex.zh: 每一处新建住宅都应达到能效标准，以降低家庭开支并减少环境损害。

words.tip: 可数名词，较正式；日常谈论自己的家通常用home。

senses.en: A star-shaped symbol used to indicate a note or omission

ex.en: An asterisk beside the price points to extra delivery charges.
ex.zh: 价格旁的星号提示还有额外运费。

ex.en: Researchers often use an asterisk in tables to indicate results that meet a particular statistical threshold.
ex.zh: 研究人员常在表格中用星号标明达到特定统计阈值的结果。

col: mark with an asterisk｜用星号标记
words.tip: 词尾是-risk，注意不要误读成-riks。

senses.en: Combine or join together to form a single whole.

ex.en: The two narrow paths merge just beyond the bridge.
ex.zh: 这两条小路在桥的那一头汇合。

ex.en: Small businesses may merge to reduce operating costs and compete more effectively with larger companies.
ex.zh: 小企业可能通过合并降低运营成本，从而更有效地与大公司竞争。

col: merge with another company｜与另一家公司合并
merge two departments｜合并两个部门
words.tip: merge with表示与……合并；merge into表示并入。

senses.en: the state of being widely known for something bad

ex.en: The restaurant gained notoriety for its dirty kitchen.
ex.zh: 这家餐馆因厨房脏乱而臭名远扬。

ex.en: Some companies gain notoriety for environmental damage, making it harder for them to attract skilled workers.
ex.zh: 一些企业因破坏环境而声名狼藉，因而更难吸引技术人才。

words.tip: 通常不可数，含贬义；中性的“名气”用fame。

senses.en: A faint light, often shining unevenly
A small sign of something, especially hope or understanding
To shine faintly or with an unsteady light

ex.en: A glimmer of candlelight escaped through the closed curtains.
ex.zh: 一缕烛光从拉拢的窗帘缝隙中透出来。

ex.en: Recent improvements in water quality offer a glimmer of hope for communities affected by industrial pollution.
ex.zh: 近期水质的改善为受工业污染影响的社区带来了一线希望。

col: a glimmer of light｜一缕微光
a glimmer of hope｜一线希望
a glimmer of understanding｜一丝领悟
words.tip: a glimmer of hope是“一线希望”的常见表达。

senses.en: an administrative system run by officials following established rules
complicated official procedures that make tasks unnecessarily difficult

ex.en: My aunt works within the city's large bureaucracy.
ex.zh: 我姑姑在这个城市庞大的行政体系内工作。

ex.en: Reducing unnecessary bureaucracy could help small businesses obtain permits more quickly without weakening essential safety standards.
ex.zh: 减少不必要的繁文缛节，能帮助小企业更快取得许可证，同时不削弱必要的安全标准。

col: excessive bureaucracy｜过度繁琐的行政手续
words.tip: bureaucracy指体制或繁琐手续；官僚个人是bureaucrat。

senses.en: To make conflicting ideas, needs, or facts compatible
To restore friendly relations after a disagreement
To help someone accept an unpleasant situation

ex.en: We reconciled our different tastes by choosing a buffet.
ex.zh: 我们选择了自助餐，兼顾了彼此不同的口味。

ex.en: Governments must reconcile the demand for affordable housing with the need to protect valuable green spaces.
ex.zh: 政府必须协调可负担住房需求与保护宝贵绿地的需要。

col: reconcile A with B｜使A与B协调
be reconciled with someone｜与某人和解
words.tip: 协调两者用with；接受现实用reconcile oneself to。

senses.en: The liquid part of blood in which blood cells float
An ionised gas containing free electrons and charged particles

ex.en: My cousin donates plasma at the local clinic.
ex.zh: 我的表亲在当地诊所捐献血浆。

ex.en: Donated plasma contains proteins that can be used to produce treatments for certain immune system disorders.
ex.zh: 捐献的血浆含有可用于生产某些免疫系统疾病治疗药物的蛋白质。

words.tip: 通常不可数；医学中指血浆，物理学中指等离子体。

senses.en: not necessary and therefore best avoided

ex.en: Calling ahead saved us a needless trip across town.
ex.zh: 提前打个电话，让我们免于白跑一趟穿过全城。

ex.en: Clear guidance on public services can prevent needless confusion and help residents access essential support.
ex.zh: 清晰的公共服务指南可以避免不必要的困惑，帮助居民获得必要的支持。

words.tip: needless to say意为“不用说”，常作插入语。

senses.en: To increase extremely quickly to a very high level.

ex.en: Our heating bills skyrocketed during the unusually cold winter.
ex.zh: 那个异常寒冷的冬天，我们的取暖费猛涨。

ex.en: Housing costs can skyrocket when population growth outpaces construction, making affordable accommodation increasingly difficult to find.
ex.zh: 当人口增长超过住房建设速度时，住房成本可能猛涨，让人越来越难找到负担得起的住所。

words.tip: 通常作不及物动词，主语常为价格、成本或需求。

senses.en: Relating to the gases surrounding Earth or another planet.
Creating a strong and distinctive mood or feeling.

ex.en: We found an atmospheric café tucked behind the old theatre.
ex.zh: 我们在老剧院后面发现了一家很有氛围的咖啡馆。

ex.en: Changes in atmospheric conditions can affect agricultural production and increase the frequency of extreme weather events.
ex.zh: 大气状况的变化会影响农业生产，并增加极端天气事件发生的频率。

col: an atmospheric setting｜富有氛围的环境
words.tip: 修饰pressure指大气的；修饰场所常指富有氛围的。

senses.en: the process of starting an organisation or system
an organisation or place where business or public activities happen
the powerful people who control a society or profession

ex.en: The establishment of our local club brought neighbours together.
ex.zh: 我们本地俱乐部的成立让邻居们走到了一起。

ex.en: The establishment of protected marine areas can help restore fish populations and support coastal communities.
ex.zh: 设立海洋保护区有助于恢复鱼类种群，并为沿海社区提供支持。

col: the political establishment｜政治权势集团
words.tip: 表示建立时不可数；表示机构时可数。

senses.en: A written message sharing information within an organisation
A formal document recording an agreement or shared intentions

ex.en: The manager sent a memorandum about our new working hours.
ex.zh: 经理发了一份关于新工作时间的内部通知。

ex.en: The two universities signed a memorandum of understanding to support joint research into renewable energy.
ex.zh: 两所大学签署了谅解备忘录，以支持可再生能源领域的联合研究。

words.tip: 常简称memo；复数为memoranda或memorandums。

senses.en: Relating to or required by a legal agreement.

ex.en: Fixing the heating is the landlord's contractual responsibility.
ex.zh: 修好暖气是房东按合同应承担的责任。

ex.en: Employers should explain contractual obligations clearly so that workers understand their rights before accepting a position.
ex.zh: 雇主应清楚说明合同义务，让劳动者在接受职位前了解自己的权利。

words.tip: 强调合同规定的权利或义务，常置于名词前。

senses.en: to praise someone or something, often publicly
to recommend someone or something as worthy of consideration

ex.en: The coach commended Lina for helping her teammates.
ex.zh: 教练表扬莉娜帮助了队友。

ex.en: Inspectors commended the school for providing additional support to students with different learning needs.
ex.zh: 督察人员赞扬该校为有不同学习需求的学生提供额外支持。

col: commend someone for something｜因某事表扬某人
commend something to someone｜向某人推荐某物
words.tip: commend是称赞；command是命令，注意拼写。

senses.en: A lack of interest, concern, or emotional response.

ex.en: Her indifference surprised me when I shared my exciting news.
ex.zh: 我分享令人兴奋的消息时，她的冷淡让我很意外。

ex.en: Public indifference to local elections can weaken accountability and reduce the quality of democratic representation.
ex.zh: 公众对地方选举漠不关心，可能削弱问责机制并降低民主代表的质量。

col: indifference to suffering｜对苦难的漠视
words.tip: 通常不可数；对某事冷漠用 indifference to。

senses.en: To be inconsistent with another statement, fact, or piece of evidence.
To say that someone else's statement is wrong.

ex.en: Your muddy shoes contradict your claim about staying indoors.
ex.zh: 你说自己一直待在室内，但你鞋上的泥可不是这么回事。

ex.en: Recent findings contradict the assumption that longer working hours necessarily lead to higher levels of productivity.
ex.zh: 近期研究结果与“工作时间越长，生产效率必然越高”的假设相矛盾。

col: contradict a claim｜与某一说法矛盾
words.tip: 及物动词，直接接人或说法；无需加with。

senses.en: To tell a story or describe a series of events.
To provide spoken commentary for a film or programme.

ex.en: My grandfather loves to narrate stories from his childhood.
ex.zh: 我祖父很喜欢讲述他童年的故事。

ex.en: Local residents narrate their experiences in the documentary, offering valuable insights into urban change.
ex.zh: 当地居民在纪录片中讲述亲身经历，为理解城市变迁提供了宝贵视角。

col: narrate a documentary｜为纪录片配旁白
words.tip: 及物动词，直接接故事或事件，无需加about。

senses.en: objects made of glass, especially drinking vessels or laboratory equipment

ex.en: Please wrap the glassware carefully before packing the box.
ex.zh: 装箱前请把玻璃器皿仔细包好。

ex.en: Reusable glassware can reduce waste in laboratories, provided that appropriate cleaning and safety procedures are followed.
ex.zh: 只要遵循适当的清洁和安全程序，可重复使用的玻璃器皿就能减少实验室废弃物。

words.tip: 不可数名词；一件玻璃器皿用a piece of glassware。

senses.en: relating to a province or its administration
relating to areas outside a country's capital
showing limited experience and unwillingness to accept different ideas

ex.en: She works at the provincial hospital near our home.
ex.zh: 她在我们家附近的省立医院工作。

ex.en: Provincial governments can adapt national education policies to meet the specific needs of local communities.
ex.zh: 省级政府可以调整国家教育政策，以满足当地社区的具体需求。

words.tip: 指省级时中性；形容人的观念时可含贬义。

senses.en: To imagine a possible future situation or event.

ex.en: I envisage turning this spare room into a studio.
ex.zh: 我设想把这间空房改成工作室。

ex.en: Urban planners envisage a future in which most residents can reach essential services on foot.
ex.zh: 城市规划者设想，未来大多数居民都能步行到达提供基本服务的场所。

col: as originally envisaged｜按最初的设想
words.tip: 后接名词、动名词或that从句，不接to do。

senses.en: Respect and admiration for someone.
To respect and admire someone highly.

ex.en: Her neighbours hold her in esteem for her kindness.
ex.zh: 邻居们因她的善良而敬重她。

ex.en: Teachers who treat students fairly often earn the lasting esteem of their local communities.
ex.zh: 公平对待学生的教师往往能赢得当地社区长久的敬重。

col: hold someone in high esteem｜非常敬重某人
earn someone's esteem｜赢得某人的敬重
words.tip: 常用hold someone in high esteem表示非常敬重某人。

senses.en: relating to courts, judges, or the administration of justice

ex.en: The lawyer explained the judicial process to our family.
ex.zh: 律师向我们一家解释了司法程序。

ex.en: An independent judicial system helps protect individual rights and ensures that governments remain accountable.
ex.zh: 独立的司法体系有助于保护个人权利，并确保政府承担责任。

words.tip: judicial指司法；judicious指明智、审慎。

senses.en: To keep something within particular limits
To keep someone in a place they cannot leave

ex.en: Please confine your muddy boots to the porch.
ex.zh: 请把沾满泥的靴子放在门廊里，别带进屋。

ex.en: Researchers should not confine their investigation to wealthy neighbourhoods when studying access to public transport.
ex.zh: 研究公共交通的可及性时，研究人员不应将调查局限于富裕社区。

col: confine something to｜将某事物限制在
be confined to bed｜卧床不起
confine oneself to｜使自己局限于
words.tip: 常用confine A to B，表示将A限制在B内。

senses.en: A material that conducts electricity less easily than most metals.

ex.en: My sister works at a factory making semiconductor chips.
ex.zh: 我姐姐在一家生产半导体芯片的工厂工作。

ex.en: Investment in semiconductor manufacturing is essential for developing reliable supplies of components used in modern electronic devices.
ex.zh: 投资半导体制造业对于确保现代电子设备所用元件的可靠供应至关重要。

words.tip: semi-表示半；半导体导电性介于导体与绝缘体之间。

senses.en: A lack of enough of something necessary.
A weakness that prevents something from working well.

ex.en: A blood test revealed that I had an iron deficiency.
ex.zh: 验血结果显示我缺铁。

ex.en: Nutritional deficiency among children can affect physical growth and reduce their ability to concentrate at school.
ex.zh: 儿童营养不足可能影响身体发育，并降低他们在学校集中注意力的能力。

words.tip: 缺某物用deficiency in；具体缺陷常用复数。

senses.en: To burn a surface slightly or damage it with heat

ex.en: The hot iron scorched my favourite cotton shirt.
ex.zh: 滚烫的熨斗把我最喜欢的棉衬衫烫焦了。

ex.en: Prolonged heatwaves can scorch crops, reducing agricultural yields and threatening food supplies in vulnerable regions.
ex.zh: 持续的热浪会使庄稼焦枯，降低农业产量，并威胁脆弱地区的粮食供应。

words.tip: 常指表面烧焦，不一定烧毁；太阳也能scorch植物。

senses.en: The matching arrangement of parts on opposite sides.

ex.en: The butterfly's open wings show beautiful symmetry in the sunlight.
ex.zh: 阳光下，蝴蝶展开的双翅呈现出优美的对称性。

ex.en: Architects often use symmetry to create buildings that appear balanced and visually pleasing to visitors.
ex.zh: 建筑师常利用对称性，使建筑在参观者眼中显得平衡而美观。

words.tip: 通常为不可数名词；形容词是symmetrical。

senses.en: The inability to read and write.
A lack of basic knowledge in a particular subject.

ex.en: Evening classes helped my grandfather overcome illiteracy and read independently.
ex.zh: 夜校课程帮助我祖父摆脱了文盲状态，能够独立阅读。

ex.en: Reducing adult illiteracy can improve employment opportunities and enable more people to participate fully in society.
ex.zh: 降低成人文盲率可以改善就业机会，让更多人充分参与社会生活。

words.tip: illiteracy指不识字的状态；指人宜用描述性表达。

senses.en: An event causing severe damage, suffering, or distress.

ex.en: The flood was a calamity for the whole village.
ex.zh: 这场洪水给整个村庄带来了灾难。

ex.en: Effective emergency planning can reduce the human and economic costs of a natural calamity.
ex.zh: 有效的应急规划可以减少自然灾难造成的人员损失和经济代价。

words.tip: 比problem严重得多，常指造成重大损失的灾难。

senses.en: Managing relations between countries through discussion and negotiation.
Skill in dealing with people without upsetting them.
